-- Graph: sampling primitives for NumberSequence + ColorSequence graphs.
-- Seed shape: {[keypointIndex] = number}. One intensity per seed makes adjacent keypoints drift together.

local function clamp(x, a, b) if x < a then return a end if x > b then return b end return x end
local function lerp(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end

local Graph = {}

-- Rolls a fresh envelope seed; each keypoint gets +-intensity*Envelope (one intensity, one sign).
function Graph.GenerateSeed(graph: NumberSequence?)
	local seed = {}
	-- Items can lack newer graphs; an empty seed makes QueryPointsWithTime fall through.
	if not graph or typeof(graph) ~= "NumberSequence" then return seed end
	local kp = graph.Keypoints
	local intensity = math.random()
	local isPositive = math.random() >= 0.5
	for i = 1, #kp do
		if kp[i].Envelope > 0 then
			if isPositive then
				seed[i] = intensity * kp[i].Envelope
			else
				seed[i] = -intensity * kp[i].Envelope
			end
		end
	end
	return seed
end

function Graph.GenerateSeeds(graph: NumberSequence, NoOfSeeds: number)
	local seeds = {}
	for i = 1, NoOfSeeds do
		seeds[i] = Graph.GenerateSeed(graph)
	end
	return seeds
end

-- Samples a NumberSequence at t in [0,1] with an optional envelope seed.
function Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t: number, graph: NumberSequence, seed: {number})
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	local keypoints = graph.Keypoints
	local n = #keypoints

	if n == 1 then return keypoints[1].Value + (seed[1] or 0) end

	local lo, hi = 1, n
	while lo < hi - 1 do
		local mid = (lo + hi) // 2
		if keypoints[mid].Time <= t then lo = mid else hi = mid end
	end
	local k1 = keypoints[lo]
	local k2 = keypoints[lo + 1]
	local span = k2.Time - k1.Time
	local point = span > 0 and (t - k1.Time) / span or 0
	local k1value = k1.Value + (seed[lo] or 0)
	local k2value = k2.Value + (seed[lo + 1] or 0)
	return k1value + ((k2value - k1value) * point)
end

-- Samples a ColorSequence at t in [0,1]; no envelope, so no seed.
function Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t: number, graph: ColorSequence)
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	local kp = graph.Keypoints
	local n = #kp
	if n == 0 then return Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
	if n == 1 then return kp[1].Value end
	if t <= kp[1].Time then return kp[1].Value end

	local lo, hi = 1, n
	while lo < hi - 1 do
		local mid = (lo + hi) // 2
		if kp[mid].Time <= t then lo = mid else hi = mid end
	end
	local k1 = kp[lo]
	local k2 = kp[lo + 1]
	local span = k2.Time - k1.Time
	local point = span > 0 and (t - k1.Time) / span or 0
	return k1.Value:Lerp(k2.Value, point)
end

-- Trapezoidal integral of a NumberSequence over [0, t] (TextureSpeed).
function Graph.IntegrateUpTo(t: number, sequence: NumberSequence, seed: {number}): number
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	local keypoints = sequence.Keypoints
	local n = #keypoints
	if n == 0 then return 0 end
	if n == 1 then return (keypoints[1].Value + (seed[1] or 0)) * t end

	local total = 0
	for i = 1, n - 1 do
		local k1 = keypoints[i]
		local k2 = keypoints[i + 1]
		if t <= k1.Time then break end

		local v1 = k1.Value + (seed[i] or 0)
		local v2 = k2.Value + (seed[i + 1] or 0)
		local segEnd = math.min(t, k2.Time)
		local segLength = segEnd - k1.Time
		local span = k2.Time - k1.Time
		local alpha = span > 0 and (segEnd - k1.Time) / span or 0
		local vEnd = v1 + (v2 - v1) * alpha

		total = total + (v1 + vEnd) / 2 * segLength
		if t <= k2.Time then break end
	end
	return total
end

-- True if the sequence is constant (one zero-envelope keypoint, or all equal).
function Graph.IsStatic(sequence: NumberSequence): boolean
	if not sequence then return true end
	local kps = sequence.Keypoints
	-- A non-zero envelope is per-particle randomness, so not static.
	if #kps == 1 then return kps[1].Envelope == 0 end
	local val = kps[1].Value
	if kps[1].Envelope ~= 0 then return false end
	for i = 2, #kps do
		if kps[i].Value ~= val or kps[i].Envelope ~= 0 then return false end
	end
	return true
end

function Graph.GetStaticValue(sequence: NumberSequence, defaultValue: number): number
	if not sequence or #sequence.Keypoints == 0 then
		return defaultValue
	end
	return sequence.Keypoints[1].Value
end

-- Merges unique sorted times of two sequences (both expose Keypoints[].Time).
local function _mergeSequenceTimes(seqA, seqB)
	local times = {}
	local seen = {}
	for _, seq in ipairs({seqA, seqB}) do
		for _, kp in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do
			if not seen[kp.Time] then
				seen[kp.Time] = true
				table.insert(times, kp.Time)
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(times)
	return times
end

function Graph.BlendGraphWithTime(GraphA: NumberSequence, GraphB: NumberSequence, SpeedGraph: NumberSequence, alpha: number)
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 1, 0, 1)
	local times = _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
	local blendFactor = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(alpha, SpeedGraph, {})

	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		local valA = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphA, {})
		local valB = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphB, {})
		table.insert(newKps, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, lerp(valA, valB, blendFactor)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(newKps)
end

function Graph.BlendColorGraphWithTime(GraphA: ColorSequence, GraphB: ColorSequence, SpeedGraph: NumberSequence, alpha: number)
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 1, 0, 1)
	local times = _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
	local blendFactor = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(alpha, SpeedGraph, {})

	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		local colorA = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphA)
		local colorB = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphB)
		table.insert(newKps, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(t, colorA:Lerp(colorB, blendFactor)))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(newKps)
end

-- Linear blend of two NumberSequences at alpha (Beam graph blender).
function Graph.LerpGraph(GraphA: NumberSequence, GraphB: NumberSequence, alpha: number): NumberSequence
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
	local times = _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		local valA = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphA, {})
		local valB = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphB, {})
		table.insert(newKps, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, lerp(valA, valB, alpha)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(newKps)
end

function Graph.LerpColorGraph(GraphA: ColorSequence, GraphB: ColorSequence, alpha: number): ColorSequence
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
	local times = _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		local colorA = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphA)
		local colorB = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphB)
		table.insert(newKps, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(t, colorA:Lerp(colorB, alpha)))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(newKps)
end

-- Caches merged times at emit so per-frame LerpGraphFast skips the merge.
function Graph.PrecomputeMergedTimes(GraphA: NumberSequence, GraphB: NumberSequence): {number}
	return _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
end

function Graph.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes(GraphA: ColorSequence, GraphB: ColorSequence): {number}
	return _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
end

-- Alpha 0/1 returns the source sequence, skipping a per-frame allocation.
function Graph.LerpGraphFast(GraphA: NumberSequence, GraphB: NumberSequence, alpha: number, mergedTimes: {number}): NumberSequence
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
	if alpha == 0 then return GraphA end
	if alpha == 1 then return GraphB end
	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(mergedTimes) do
		local valA = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphA, {})
		local valB = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphB, {})
		table.insert(newKps, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, lerp(valA, valB, alpha)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(newKps)
end

function Graph.LerpColorGraphFast(GraphA: ColorSequence, GraphB: ColorSequence, alpha: number, mergedTimes: {number}): ColorSequence
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
	if alpha == 0 then return GraphA end
	if alpha == 1 then return GraphB end
	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(mergedTimes) do
		local colorA = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphA)
		local colorB = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphB)
		table.insert(newKps, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(t, colorA:Lerp(colorB, alpha)))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(newKps)
end

-- Collects Beam GraphBlender states from Configuration children (Time/Transparency/Color attrs).
-- A state's optional Transition graph eases the blend INTO it (x = linear segment alpha).
function Graph.CollectGraphStates(graphBlender)
	local transStates, colorStates = {}, {}
	if not graphBlender then return transStates, colorStates end

	for _, child in pairs(graphBlender:GetChildren()) do
		if not child:IsA("Configuration") then continue end
		local time = child:GetAttribute("Time")
		if time == nil then
			local num = tonumber(string.match(child.Name, "%d+"))
			time = num and (num - 1) or 0
		end
		local transition = child:GetAttribute("Transition")
		if typeof(transition) ~= "NumberSequence" then transition = nil end
		local trans = child:GetAttribute("Transparency")
		if trans and typeof(trans) == "NumberSequence" then
			table.insert(transStates, {Time = time, Graph = trans, Transition = transition})
		end
		local color = child:GetAttribute("Color")
		if color and typeof(color) == "ColorSequence" then
			table.insert(colorStates, {Time = time, Graph = color, Transition = transition})
		end
	end

	table.sort(transStates, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
	table.sort(colorStates, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
	-- Normalizes fallback values into 0-1.
	for _, states in ipairs({transStates, colorStates}) do
		if #states > 1 and states[#states].Time > 1 then
			local maxTime = states[#states].Time
			if maxTime > 0 then for _, s in ipairs(states) do s.Time = s.Time / maxTime end end
		end
	end

	return transStates, colorStates
end

-- Initial _effectiveElapsed for a particle whose Timescale starts negative: ts(0) < 0 starts at the
-- end of life (i=1) and rewinds; otherwise 0.
function Graph.InitialEffectiveElapsed(graph, seed, lifeTime)
	if not graph or typeof(graph) ~= "NumberSequence" then return 0 end
	-- Empty seed: i=0 is deterministic on the first keypoint regardless of envelope.
	local ts0 = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(0, graph, seed or {})
	return (ts0 < 0) and lifeTime or 0
end

-- Scales a NumberSequence: values *= factor, envelopes *= abs(factor).
function Graph.ScaleSequence(seq, factor)
	if not seq or typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then return seq end
	local kps = seq.Keypoints
	local new = {}
	local absFactor = math.abs(factor)
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		table.insert(new, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, kp.Value * factor, kp.Envelope * absFactor))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(new)
end

return Graph

--[[
	Highlight mixin: Emit + Update for Highlight particles. Non-spatial. Animates FillColor /
	FillTransparency / OutlineColor / OutlineTransparency over Lifetime via NumberSequence and
	ColorSequence graphs. Adornee is resolved at emit: ObjectValue child, then link (a nested emit
	adorns the emitted parent clone), then source.Adornee, then source.Parent.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local ContainerFade = require(script.Parent.Container.Fade)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)

return function(Particle)

-- Per-frame update: samples the four graphs at the current life step; the SetTimescale override gates the time axis.
function Particle:UpdateHighlight(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse timescale as Update.luau UpdatePart; the SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local steppedI = pData.CurrentStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames

		if pData.Graphs.HLFillColor and not pData.SkipColor then
			pData.VisualPart.FillColor = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.HLFillColor)
		end
		-- A Container's Transparency fades both on top of their own (Container/Fade); at no fade their own values are written once.
		local fade = ContainerFade.of(pData._drive)
		local faded = fade ~= 0 or pData._hlFaded
		pData._hlFaded = fade ~= 0
		if (pData.Graphs.HLFillTransparency or faded) and not pData.SkipTransparency then
			local fill = pData._fillBase
			if pData.Graphs.HLFillTransparency then
				fill = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.HLFillTransparency, pData.Seeds.HLFillTransparency)
			end
			pData.VisualPart.FillTransparency = ContainerFade.number(fill, fade)
		end
		if pData.Graphs.HLOutlineColor and not pData.SkipColor then
			pData.VisualPart.OutlineColor = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.HLOutlineColor)
		end
		if (pData.Graphs.HLOutlineTransparency or faded) and not pData.SkipTransparency then
			local outline = pData._outlineBase
			if pData.Graphs.HLOutlineTransparency then
				outline = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.HLOutlineTransparency, pData.Seeds.HLOutlineTransparency)
			end
			pData.VisualPart.OutlineTransparency = ContainerFade.number(outline, fade)
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

-- Adornee: ObjectValue child, link, source.Adornee, then source.Parent if it is a BasePart or Model.
-- During a nested emit the link is the emitted parent clone, so the highlight tracks the particle,
-- not the hidden source RenderTemplate. Attachment links adorn their holder part. Returning nil
-- skips rendering, rather than adorning Workspace and highlighting the whole place.
local function _resolveAdornee(data, source, link)
	if data.Adornee then return data.Adornee end
	if link then
		if link:IsA("BasePart") or link:IsA("Model") then return link end
		if link:IsA("Attachment") then
			local holder = link.Parent
			if holder and (holder:IsA("BasePart") or holder:IsA("Model")) then return holder end
		end
	end
	local cur = source.Adornee
	if cur then return cur end
	local p = source.Parent
	if p and (p:IsA("BasePart") or p:IsA("Model")) then return p end
	return nil
end

-- Spawns a Highlight particle: clones the RenderTemplate, resolves Adornee, registers in ActiveEmits.
function Particle:EmitHighlight(highlight, link, emitCtx)
	if not highlight or not highlight.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(highlight, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	-- PoolHide set Enabled=false on release; it is flipped back here.
	local visual = Pool.acquireOrClone(data.RenderTemplate, "Highlight", data.Pool)
	visual.Archivable = false
	visual.Enabled = true
	if data.HLDepthMode then visual.DepthMode = data.HLDepthMode end
	visual.Adornee = _resolveAdornee(data, highlight, link)
	-- Renders through Adornee; the instance lives in a local clone or the live folder, never the user's part.
	local parentInstance = data.EmitParent or link or self:GetFolder()

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end

	local seedFillTrans = data.HLFillTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.HLFillTransparency) or {}
	local seedOutlineTrans = data.HLOutlineTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.HLOutlineTransparency) or {}
	local seedTimescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.HLTimescale)

	-- Initial values are applied before parenting to avoid a 1-frame pop.
	if data.HLFillColor then
		visual.FillColor = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, data.HLFillColor)
	end
	if data.HLFillTransparency then
		visual.FillTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.HLFillTransparency, seedFillTrans)
	end
	if data.HLOutlineColor then
		visual.OutlineColor = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, data.HLOutlineColor)
	end
	if data.HLOutlineTransparency then
		visual.OutlineTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.HLOutlineTransparency, seedOutlineTrans)
	end
	-- Carried by a Container: its fade is on from the first frame.
	local containerDrive = emitCtx and emitCtx._containerDrive
	local fillBase, outlineBase = visual.FillTransparency, visual.OutlineTransparency
	if containerDrive then
		visual.FillTransparency = ContainerFade.number(fillBase, containerDrive.transparency)
		visual.OutlineTransparency = ContainerFade.number(outlineBase, containerDrive.transparency)
	end

	visual.Parent = parentInstance

	local pData = {
		Type = "Highlight",
		VisualPart = visual,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,

		Graphs = {
			HLFillColor = data.HLFillColor,
			HLFillTransparency = data.HLFillTransparency,
			HLOutlineColor = data.HLOutlineColor,
			HLOutlineTransparency = data.HLOutlineTransparency,
			Timescale = data.HLTimescale,
		},
		Seeds = {
			HLFillTransparency = seedFillTrans,
			HLOutlineTransparency = seedOutlineTrans,
			Timescale = seedTimescale,
		},
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.HLTimescale, seedTimescale, safeLifeTime),
	}

	pData._sourceItem = highlight
	pData._drive = containerDrive
	pData._fillBase = fillBase
	pData._outlineBase = outlineBase
	pData._hlFaded = containerDrive ~= nil and containerDrive.transparency ~= 0
	if ContainerFade.fading(containerDrive) then pData._noPool = true end
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, highlight)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Highlight" end
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Animate mode operates on the live RenderTemplate (no clone). Lifecycle.cancelAnimation restores
-- the intrinsic fill and outline colours and transparencies.
function Particle:EmitHighlightAnimate(highlight, link, emitCtx)
	if not highlight or not highlight.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[highlight] then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(highlight, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local visual = data.RenderTemplate -- LIVE source, not a clone

	-- Snapshot BEFORE mutating so cancelAnimation restores the authored values.
	local snapshot = {
		FillColor = visual.FillColor,
		FillTransparency = visual.FillTransparency,
		OutlineColor = visual.OutlineColor,
		OutlineTransparency = visual.OutlineTransparency,
		DepthMode = visual.DepthMode,
		Adornee = visual.Adornee,
		Enabled = visual.Enabled,
	}

	visual.Enabled = true
	if data.HLDepthMode then visual.DepthMode = data.HLDepthMode end
	visual.Adornee = _resolveAdornee(data, highlight, link)

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end

	local seedFillTrans = data.HLFillTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.HLFillTransparency) or {}
	local seedOutlineTrans = data.HLOutlineTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.HLOutlineTransparency) or {}
	local seedTimescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.HLTimescale)

	local pData = {
		Type = "Highlight",
		VisualPart = visual,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		IsAnimate = true,
		AnimateItem = highlight,
		HighlightSnapshot = snapshot,

		Graphs = {
			HLFillColor = data.HLFillColor,
			HLFillTransparency = data.HLFillTransparency,
			HLOutlineColor = data.HLOutlineColor,
			HLOutlineTransparency = data.HLOutlineTransparency,
			Timescale = data.HLTimescale,
		},
		Seeds = {
			HLFillTransparency = seedFillTrans,
			HLOutlineTransparency = seedOutlineTrans,
			Timescale = seedTimescale,
		},
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.HLTimescale, seedTimescale, safeLifeTime),
	}

	pData._sourceItem = highlight
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, highlight)
	self.ActiveAnimates[highlight] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

end

--[[
	HitFilter: type-level raycast filter for one emitter, a collision group plus an exclude list, stored
	on PartIcleProperties as the HitFilterGroup attribute and the HitFilterExclude folder of
	ObjectValues. Read by Events.makeHitParams (OnHit), Rocks and Lightning Seek; written by the
	HitFilterPanel. Requires TypeRegistry only.
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)

local HitFilter = {}

local GROUP_ATTR = "HitFilterGroup"
local FOLDER_NAME = "HitFilterExclude"

local function getConfig(item)
	if not item then return nil end
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not typeDef or typeDef.directAccess then return nil end
	return TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
end

local function readExcludes(folder, out)
	if not folder then return out end
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("ObjectValue") and child.Value then table.insert(out, child.Value) end
	end
	return out
end

-- Legacy location: the OnHit event cfg's CollisionGroup attribute and ExcludeList folder.
local function legacyEventCfg(config)
	local events = config:FindFirstChild("Events")
	local cfg = events and events:FindFirstChild("OnHit")
	if cfg and cfg:IsA("Configuration") then return cfg end
	return nil
end

-- Returns the group name ("" = unset) and an array of excluded Instances. Falls back to the legacy
-- per-event location until migrateFromEvent has run.
function HitFilter.read(item)
	local config = getConfig(item)
	if not config then return "", {} end
	return HitFilter.readConfig(config)
end

-- Types whose rays read the filter though they have no OnHit event: a Reactor's pieces
-- (GetDataRig.readReactor, Reactor/Entries). The OnHit types are EventsSchema's.
local WITHOUT_ON_HIT = { Reactor = true }

-- Whether an item's rays read the filter without an OnHit event (HitFilterPanel).
function HitFilter.appliesWithoutEvents(item)
	local _, typeName = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	return WITHOUT_ON_HIT[typeName] == true
end

-- HitFilter.read for a config in hand.
function HitFilter.readConfig(config)
	local group = config:GetAttribute(GROUP_ATTR)
	if type(group) ~= "string" then group = "" end
	local excludes = readExcludes(config:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME), {})
	if group == "" and #excludes == 0 then
		local legacy = legacyEventCfg(config)
		if legacy then
			local legacyGroup = legacy:GetAttribute("CollisionGroup")
			if type(legacyGroup) == "string" then group = legacyGroup end
			readExcludes(legacy:FindFirstChild("ExcludeList"), excludes)
		end
	end
	return group, excludes
end

-- "" or nil clears the group.
function HitFilter.setGroup(item, groupName)
	local config = getConfig(item)
	if not config then return false end
	if type(groupName) ~= "string" or groupName == "" then groupName = nil end
	config:SetAttribute(GROUP_ATTR, groupName)
	return true
end

local function excludeFolder(config, create)
	local folder = config:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if folder or not create then return folder end
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = FOLDER_NAME
	folder.Parent = config
	return folder
end

function HitFilter.addExclude(item, inst)
	local config = getConfig(item)
	if not config or not inst then return false end
	local folder = excludeFolder(config, true)
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("ObjectValue") and child.Value == inst then return false end
	end
	local objectValue = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
	objectValue.Name = "Exclude"
	objectValue.Value = inst
	objectValue.Parent = folder
	return true
end

function HitFilter.removeExclude(item, inst)
	local config = getConfig(item)
	local folder = config and excludeFolder(config, false)
	if not folder then return false end
	local removed = false
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("ObjectValue") and child.Value == inst then
			-- Taken out, not destroyed: Studio's undo gives back only what was not destroyed.
			child.Parent = nil
			removed = true
		end
	end
	if #folder:GetChildren() == 0 then folder.Parent = nil end
	return removed
end

-- Moves a legacy per-event filter to the type level. Existing type-level values win. `cfg` defaults
-- to the item's OnHit cfg. Returns true when anything changed.
function HitFilter.migrateFromEvent(item, cfg)
	local config = getConfig(item)
	if not config then return false end
	cfg = cfg or legacyEventCfg(config)
	if not cfg then return false end
	local changed = false
	local legacyGroup = cfg:GetAttribute("CollisionGroup")
	if legacyGroup ~= nil then
		if type(legacyGroup) == "string" and legacyGroup ~= "" and config:GetAttribute(GROUP_ATTR) == nil then
			config:SetAttribute(GROUP_ATTR, legacyGroup)
		end
		cfg:SetAttribute("CollisionGroup", nil)
		changed = true
	end
	local legacy = cfg:FindFirstChild("ExcludeList")
	if legacy then
		for _, inst in ipairs(readExcludes(legacy, {})) do HitFilter.addExclude(item, inst) end
		legacy.Parent = nil
		changed = true
	end
	return changed
end

return HitFilter

-- ImageEmit  -  Emit, Animate and Update for ImageLabels: 2D motion and flipbook. Position moves by
-- (Speed x direction + envVel) x dt; Acceleration and Drag drive envVel.

local Preload = require(script.Parent.Preload)
local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local ContainerFade = require(script.Parent.Container.Fade)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local ScreenHost = require(script.Parent.ScreenHost)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local StaticPass = require(script.Parent.StaticPass)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

return function(Particle)

-- One warning per image, however fast it emits.
local _warnedSheets = {}

-- The parent: EmitParent, else the parent copy's Gui (nested), else the nearest emitted ancestor,
-- else ScreenHost.
local function resolveImageParent(data, source, emitCtx)
	if data.EmitParent then return data.EmitParent end
	local map = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentCloneMap
	if map and source and source.Parent and map[source.Parent] then return map[source.Parent] end
	if source then
		local cur = source.Parent
		while cur and cur ~= game do
			if cur:GetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit") then return source.Parent end
			cur = cur.Parent
		end
	end
	return ScreenHost.get()
end

-- Sorted Decal children of ImageFlipbooks (numeric name).
local function gatherFlipbookDecals(folder)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local list = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Decal") then table.insert(list, child) end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		local an, bn = tonumber(a.Name), tonumber(b.Name)
		if an and bn then return an < bn end
		return a.Name < b.Name
	end)
	return #list > 0 and list or nil
end

-- Fire-and-forget preload of the image and the flipbook's Decals (Preload: by instance).
local function preloadEmitAssets(data, decals)
	local assetList = {}
	if decals then for _, d in ipairs(decals) do table.insert(assetList, d) end end
	if data.Image and data.Image ~= "" then table.insert(assetList, data.Image) end
	if #assetList == 0 then return end
	Preload.ask(assetList)
end

-- Waits for the preload on a RenderTemplate's first emit only (Particle._preloadedAssets).
local function preloadAndWait(particle, rt, data, decals)
	if not particle or not rt then return end
	local cache = particle._preloadedAssets
	if not cache then return end
	if cache:get(rt) then return end
	local assetList = {}
	if decals then for _, d in ipairs(decals) do table.insert(assetList, d) end end
	if data.Image and data.Image ~= "" then table.insert(assetList, data.Image) end
	cache:set(rt, true) -- marked before the yield, so emits meanwhile do not wait twice
	if #assetList == 0 then return end
	Preload.wait(assetList)
end

-- The frame for each FlipbookMode: OneShot and PingPong over Lifetime, Loop by framerate, Random
-- one per interval. StartRandom is Loop only.
local function resolveFrame(pData, n, elapsed)
	if n <= 0 then return 0 end
	local mode = pData.FlipbookMode
	local frame
	if mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot then
		local t = pData.LifeTime > 0 and math.min(1, elapsed / pData.LifeTime) or 1
		frame = math.min(math.floor(t * n), n - 1)
	elseif mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.PingPong then
		local t = pData.LifeTime > 0 and math.min(1, elapsed / pData.LifeTime) or 1
		local cyc = t * 2
		if cyc <= 1 then frame = math.floor(cyc * n) else frame = math.floor((2 - cyc) * n) end
		frame = math.max(0, math.min(frame, n - 1))
	elseif mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Random then
		local fr = pData.FlipbookFramerate or 24
		local interval = (fr > 0) and (1 / fr) or 1
		local intervalIdx = math.floor(elapsed / interval)
		if pData._lastRandomInterval ~= intervalIdx then
			pData._lastRandomInterval = intervalIdx
			pData._currentRandomFrame = math.random(0, n - 1)
		end
		frame = pData._currentRandomFrame or math.random(0, n - 1)
	else -- Loop (default)
		local raw = elapsed * pData.FlipbookFramerate + (pData.FlipbookStartOffset or 0) * n
		frame = math.floor(raw) % n
	end
	if pData.FlipbookReverse then frame = n - 1 - frame end
	return frame
end

-- Decals swap Image; a spritesheet shifts ImageRectOffset. Written only when the frame changes.
local function applyFlipbookFrame(pData, elapsed)
	if not pData.FlipbookFramerate or pData.FlipbookFramerate <= 0 then return end
	if pData.FlipbookSource == "Decals" and pData.FlipbookDecals then
		local n = #pData.FlipbookDecals
		if n == 0 then return end
		local frame = resolveFrame(pData, n, elapsed)
		if frame == pData._lastFlipbookFrame then return end
		pData._lastFlipbookFrame = frame
		local dec = pData.FlipbookDecals[frame + 1]
		if dec and dec.Texture then pData.VisualPart.Image = dec.Texture end
	elseif pData.FlipbookSource == "Spritesheet" then
		local cols = math.max(1, pData.GridCols or 1)
		local rows = math.max(1, pData.GridRows or 1)
		local total = cols * rows
		local frame = resolveFrame(pData, total, elapsed)
		local sheet = pData.SheetSize
		if not sheet then return end
		if frame == pData._lastFlipbookFrame then return end
		pData._lastFlipbookFrame = frame
		local fw, fh = sheet.X / cols, sheet.Y / rows
		pData.VisualPart.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(fw, fh)
		pData.VisualPart.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new((frame % cols) * fw, math.floor(frame / cols) * fh)
	end
end

-- Integrates the 2D motion over Lifetime (60 steps, as UpdateImageLabel) for InvertMotion's start:
-- the end position and velocity, from which negative time retraces the path.
local function _simulateForward2D(data, dirX, dirY, lifetime, seeds)
	local steps = 60
	local stepDt = lifetime / steps
	local accelX = (data.ImgAcceleration or Vector2.new()).X
	local accelY = (data.ImgAcceleration or Vector2.new()).Y
	local drag = data.ImgDrag or 0
	local posX, posY = 0, 0
	local envX, envY = 0, 0
	for s = 1, steps do
		local t = s / steps
		local speed = 0
		if data.ImgSpeed then
			speed = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, data.ImgSpeed, seeds.ImgSpeed) * 100
		end
		envX += accelX * 100 * stepDt
		envY += accelY * 100 * stepDt
		if drag > 0 then
			local decay = math.max(0, 1 - drag * stepDt)
			envX *= decay; envY *= decay
		end
		posX += (speed * dirX + envX) * stepDt
		posY += (speed * dirY + envY) * stepDt
	end
	return posX, posY, envX, envY
end

-- For Engine's AnimateLoop replay.
Particle._computeImageLabelEndState = function(_self, data, dirX, dirY, lifetime, seeds)
	return _simulateForward2D(data, dirX, dirY, lifetime, seeds)
end

-- pData from data, for Emit and Animate.
local function buildImageLabelPData(data, visual, item, isAnimate)
	local flipbookDecals = gatherFlipbookDecals(data.ImageFlipbooks)
	-- EmissionAngle: 0=right, 90=up, 180=left, 270=down. GUI Y is inverted.
	local ea = data.ImgEmissionAngle or 90
	local sp = data.ImgSpreadAngle or 0
	local angle = ea + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * sp
	local rad = math.rad(angle)
	local dx, dy = math.cos(rad), -math.sin(rad)
	-- InvertMotion: spawn at the path's end and run time backwards; the direction stays.

	local safeLife = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLife <= 0 then safeLife = 0.001 end

	local seeds = {
		ImageTransparency      = data.ImageTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ImageTransparency) or {},
		BackgroundTransparency = data.BackgroundTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.BackgroundTransparency) or {},
		ImgSpeed               = data.ImgSpeed and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ImgSpeed) or {},
		ImgRotSpeed            = data.ImgRotSpeed and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ImgRotSpeed) or {},
		SizeScaleX             = data.SizeScaleX and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeScaleX) or {},
		SizeScaleY             = data.SizeScaleY and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeScaleY) or {},
		Timescale              = data.ImgTimescale and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ImgTimescale) or {},
	}

	local initialRot = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ImgRotRange or NumberRange.new(0))
	local baseSize = data.ImgSizeUDim or UDim2.fromOffset(100, 100)

	-- Frame 0, no pop.
	if data.ImageTransparency then visual.ImageTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.ImageTransparency, seeds.ImageTransparency) end
	if data.BackgroundTransparency then visual.BackgroundTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.BackgroundTransparency, seeds.BackgroundTransparency) end
	if data.ImageColor3 then visual.ImageColor3 = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, data.ImageColor3) end
	if data.BackgroundColor3 then visual.BackgroundColor3 = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, data.BackgroundColor3) end
	visual.Image = data.Image or ""
	visual.ScaleType = data.ImgScaleType or Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	visual.ResampleMode = data.ImgResampleMode or Enum.ResamplerMode.Default
	visual.AnchorPoint = data.ImgAnchorPoint or Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	visual.ZIndex = data.ImgZIndex or 1
	visual.Rotation = initialRot
	local sx0 = data.SizeScaleX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.SizeScaleX, seeds.SizeScaleX) or 1
	local sy0 = data.SizeScaleY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.SizeScaleY, seeds.SizeScaleY) or 1
	visual.Size = UDim2.new(baseSize.X.Scale * sx0, baseSize.X.Offset * sx0, baseSize.Y.Scale * sy0, baseSize.Y.Offset * sy0)
	visual.Position = data.ImgPosition or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)

	local framerate = 10
	if data.ImgFlipbookFramerate then framerate = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ImgFlipbookFramerate) end

	-- StartRandom (Loop only): one start frame for the setup and the loop, so the first frame does not snap.
	local mode = data.ImgFlipbookMode or Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop
	local applyStartRandom = data.ImgFlipbookStartRandom and mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop
	local startFrame = 0
	local startFrameOffset = 0

	-- No sheet size: the whole sheet. Decals mode ignores it.
	local sheetSize = data.SheetSize

	-- Frame 0's flipbook set up at once.
	local source = data.ImgFlipbookSource or "Decals"
	-- A spritesheet without SheetSize cannot crop: warn once per image.
	if source == "Spritesheet" and not sheetSize and data.Image and data.Image ~= "" and not _warnedSheets[data.Image] then
		_warnedSheets[data.Image] = true
		Log.warn(string.format("Part-Icles: Spritesheet flipbook  -  sheet dimensions unknown for %s. Emit will render full sheet until dimensions resolve.", data.Image))
	end
	if source == "Decals" then
		-- Clear an old crop.
		visual.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(0, 0); visual.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		if flipbookDecals and #flipbookDecals > 0 then
			local n = #flipbookDecals
			if applyStartRandom then
				startFrame = math.random(0, n - 1)
				startFrameOffset = startFrame / n
			end
			local dec = flipbookDecals[startFrame + 1]
			if dec and dec.Texture and dec.Texture ~= "" then visual.Image = dec.Texture end
		end
	elseif source == "Spritesheet" and sheetSize then
		local cols = math.max(1, data.ImgGridCols or 1)
		local rows = math.max(1, data.ImgGridRows or 1)
		local total = cols * rows
		if applyStartRandom and total > 0 then
			startFrame = math.random(0, total - 1)
			startFrameOffset = startFrame / total
		end
		local fw, fh = sheetSize.X / cols, sheetSize.Y / rows
		visual.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(fw, fh)
		visual.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new((startFrame % cols) * fw, math.floor(startFrame / cols) * fh)
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "ImageLabel",
		VisualPart = visual,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		LifeTime = safeLife,
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames or 100),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,

		BasePosition = data.ImgPosition or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		BaseSize = baseSize,
		DirX = dx, DirY = dy,
		EnvVelX = 0, EnvVelY = 0,
		PosX = 0,  PosY = 0,
		AccelX = (data.ImgAcceleration or Vector2.new()).X,
		AccelY = (data.ImgAcceleration or Vector2.new()).Y,
		Drag = data.ImgDrag or 0,

		InitialRotation = initialRot,
		RotMode = data.ImgRotMode or "OverLife",
		AccRot = 0,
		InvertMotion = data.ImgInvertMotion or false,

		Graphs = {
			ImageTransparency      = data.ImageTransparency,
			BackgroundTransparency = data.BackgroundTransparency,
			ImgSpeed               = data.ImgSpeed,
			ImgRotSpeed            = data.ImgRotSpeed,
			SizeScaleX             = data.SizeScaleX,
			SizeScaleY             = data.SizeScaleY,
			ImageColor3            = data.ImageColor3,
			BackgroundColor3       = data.BackgroundColor3,
			Timescale              = data.ImgTimescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.ImgTimescale, seeds.Timescale, safeLife),

		FlipbookSource   = data.ImgFlipbookSource or "Decals",
		FlipbookMode     = data.ImgFlipbookMode or Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop,
		FlipbookFramerate = framerate,
		FlipbookStartOffset = startFrameOffset,
		FlipbookReverse  = data.ImgFlipbookReverse or false,
		FlipbookDecals   = flipbookDecals,
		SheetSize = sheetSize,
		GridCols = data.ImgGridCols or 8,
		GridRows = data.ImgGridRows or 1,

		IsAnimate = isAnimate or nil,
		AnimateItem = isAnimate and item or nil,
	}

	-- InvertMotion: position and velocity start at the forward path's end, time runs from Lifetime to 0.
	if data.ImgInvertMotion then
		local endX, endY, endVelX, endVelY = _simulateForward2D(data, dx, dy, safeLife, seeds)
		pData.PosX, pData.PosY = endX, endY
		pData.EnvVelX, pData.EnvVelY = endVelX, endVelY
		pData._effectiveElapsed = safeLife
		pData._invertDtSign = -1
	end

	-- Constant graphs become values (StaticPass); frame 0 already wrote them.
	StaticPass.apply(pData)
	-- Both size axes constant: none sampled per frame.
	if pData._staticSizeScaleX and pData._staticSizeScaleY then
		pData._staticSizeScaleX = nil
		pData._staticSizeScaleY = nil
	end

	return pData
end

function Particle:EmitImageLabel(item, link, emitCtx)
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	-- The first emit of a RenderTemplate waits for its preload.
	preloadAndWait(self, data.RenderTemplate, data, nil)

	-- Copies come without ImageFlipbooks (pData.FlipbookDecals has them).
	local visual = Pool.acquireOrClone(data.RenderTemplate, "ImageLabel", data.Pool)
	visual.Archivable = false
	visual.Visible = true
	local cloneFF = visual:FindFirstChild("ImageFlipbooks")
	if cloneFF then cloneFF:Destroy() end

	local pData = buildImageLabelPData(data, visual, item, false)
	pData.Link = link
	pData._sourceItem = item
	-- Under a Container: its fade from the first frame; a faded visual stays out of the pool.
	local containerDrive = emitCtx and emitCtx._containerDrive
	pData._drive = containerDrive
	pData._imageBase = visual.ImageTransparency
	pData._backgroundBase = visual.BackgroundTransparency
	if containerDrive then
		visual.ImageTransparency = ContainerFade.number(pData._imageBase, containerDrive.transparency)
		visual.BackgroundTransparency = ContainerFade.number(pData._backgroundBase, containerDrive.transparency)
		pData._imageFaded = containerDrive.transparency ~= 0
	end
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	pData.Events = data.Events
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "ImageLabel" end
	if ContainerFade.fading(containerDrive) then pData._noPool = true end
	preloadEmitAssets(data, pData.FlipbookDecals)
	visual.Parent = resolveImageParent(data, item, emitCtx)
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	-- Nested ImageLabels parent beside the source; Scale stays relative.
	for _, desc in visual:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") and desc:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			self:EnableEmit(desc, nil, emitCtx)
		end
	end
end

-- A single copy; a second emit while it plays is refused.
function Particle:EmitImageLabelAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
	if self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	-- The first emit of a RenderTemplate waits for its preload.
	preloadAndWait(self, data.RenderTemplate, data, nil)

	local visual = data.RenderTemplate:Clone()
	visual.Archivable = false
	visual.Visible = true
	visual:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	local cloneFF = visual:FindFirstChild("ImageFlipbooks"); if cloneFF then cloneFF:Destroy() end

	local pData = buildImageLabelPData(data, visual, item, true)
	pData.Link = link
	pData._sourceItem = item
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	pData.Events = data.Events
	preloadEmitAssets(data, pData.FlipbookDecals)
	visual.Parent = resolveImageParent(data, item, emitCtx)
	self.ActiveAnimates[item] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	for _, desc in visual:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") and desc:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			self:EnableEmit(desc, nil, emitCtx)
		end
	end
end

-- Per frame; true when the life ends.
function Particle:UpdateImageLabel(pData, dt, currentTime)
	local visual = pData.VisualPart
	if not visual or not visual.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end

	-- The signed timescale header, as in UpdatePart; SetTimescale wins in its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	dt = dt * ts
	-- InvertMotion: time runs backwards from Lifetime.
	if pData._invertDtSign then dt = dt * pData._invertDtSign end
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	-- Clamped, so boundary frames take a partial step.
	dt = newEff - priorEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsed = newEff
	local i = elapsed / lifeTime
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	if i > 1 then i = 1 end
	if i < 0 then i = 0 end

	-- Writes happen when the step advances (TotalKeyFrames), the dt between added up; the flipbook runs
	-- per frame at its own framerate.
	local graphs = pData.Graphs
	local seeds = pData.Seeds
	pData.AccumulatedDT = (pData.AccumulatedDT or 0) + dt

	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		local frameDT = pData.AccumulatedDT
		pData.AccumulatedDT = 0
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local t = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames

		-- Speed at the step; Drag decays in closed form.
		local speed = 0
		if pData._staticImgSpeed then
			speed = pData._staticImgSpeed * 100
		elseif graphs.ImgSpeed then
			speed = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.ImgSpeed, seeds.ImgSpeed) * 100
		end
		if speed ~= 0 and pData.Drag > 0 then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsed) end

		-- envVel integrates Acceleration over the batch; Drag linear (the batch is one step at most).
		pData.EnvVelX += pData.AccelX * 100 * frameDT
		pData.EnvVelY += pData.AccelY * 100 * frameDT
		if pData.Drag > 0 then
			local decay = math.max(0, 1 - pData.Drag * frameDT)
			pData.EnvVelX *= decay; pData.EnvVelY *= decay
		end

		local vx = speed * pData.DirX + pData.EnvVelX
		local vy = speed * pData.DirY + pData.EnvVelY
		pData.PosX += vx * frameDT
		pData.PosY += vy * frameDT
		local bp = pData.BasePosition
		visual.Position = UDim2.new(bp.X.Scale, bp.X.Offset + pData.PosX, bp.Y.Scale, bp.Y.Offset + pData.PosY)

		-- OverLife: an angle; Speed: degrees a second. Both plus InitialRotation.
		local rs
		if pData._staticImgRotSpeed then
			rs = pData._staticImgRotSpeed
		elseif graphs.ImgRotSpeed then
			rs = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.ImgRotSpeed, seeds.ImgRotSpeed)
		end
		if rs then
			local newRot
			if pData.RotMode == "Speed" then
				pData.AccRot += rs * frameDT
				newRot = pData.InitialRotation + pData.AccRot
			else
				newRot = pData.InitialRotation + rs
			end
			if newRot ~= pData._lastRotation then
				visual.Rotation = newRot
				pData._lastRotation = newRot
			end
		end

		local hasSizeX = pData._staticSizeScaleX or graphs.SizeScaleX
		local hasSizeY = pData._staticSizeScaleY or graphs.SizeScaleY
		if (hasSizeX or hasSizeY) and not pData.SkipSize then
			local sx = pData._staticSizeScaleX
				or (graphs.SizeScaleX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.SizeScaleX, seeds.SizeScaleX))
				or 1
			local sy = pData._staticSizeScaleY
				or (graphs.SizeScaleY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.SizeScaleY, seeds.SizeScaleY))
				or 1
			if sx ~= pData._lastSizeX or sy ~= pData._lastSizeY then
				local bs = pData.BaseSize
				visual.Size = UDim2.new(bs.X.Scale * sx, bs.X.Offset * sx, bs.Y.Scale * sy, bs.Y.Offset * sy)
				pData._lastSizeX, pData._lastSizeY = sx, sy
			end
		end

		-- Colour and transparency unless skipped by a script; a Container's Transparency fades both on top
		-- (back at none, their own values are written once).
		local fade = ContainerFade.of(pData._drive)
		local faded = fade ~= 0 or pData._imageFaded
		pData._imageFaded = fade ~= 0
		if (graphs.ImageTransparency or faded) and not pData.SkipTransparency then
			local own = pData._imageBase
			if graphs.ImageTransparency then own = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.ImageTransparency, seeds.ImageTransparency) end
			visual.ImageTransparency = ContainerFade.number(own, fade)
		end
		if (graphs.BackgroundTransparency or faded) and not pData.SkipTransparency then
			local own = pData._backgroundBase
			if graphs.BackgroundTransparency then own = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.BackgroundTransparency, seeds.BackgroundTransparency) end
			visual.BackgroundTransparency = ContainerFade.number(own, fade)
		end
		if graphs.ImageColor3 and not pData.SkipColor then visual.ImageColor3 = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.ImageColor3) end
		if graphs.BackgroundColor3 and not pData.SkipColor then visual.BackgroundColor3 = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.BackgroundColor3) end
	end

	-- The flipbook runs per frame at its own framerate.
	applyFlipbookFrame(pData, elapsed)

	return isDying
end

-- AnimateLoop refresh of the non-spatial fields.
function Particle:_refreshImageLabelAnimateNonSpatial(pData, freshData)
	if not freshData then return end
	local ea = freshData.ImgEmissionAngle or 90
	local sp = freshData.ImgSpreadAngle or 0
	local angle = ea + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * sp
	local rad = math.rad(angle)
	local dx, dy = math.cos(rad), -math.sin(rad)
	pData.DirX = dx; pData.DirY = dy
	if freshData.ImgAcceleration then
		pData.AccelX = freshData.ImgAcceleration.X
		pData.AccelY = freshData.ImgAcceleration.Y
	end
	if freshData.ImgDrag ~= nil then pData.Drag = freshData.ImgDrag end
	if freshData.ImgPosition then pData.BasePosition = freshData.ImgPosition end
	if freshData.ImgSizeUDim then pData.BaseSize = freshData.ImgSizeUDim end
	if freshData.ImgRotMode then pData.RotMode = freshData.ImgRotMode end
	if freshData.ImgRotRange then pData.InitialRotation = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.ImgRotRange) end
	if freshData.ImgFlipbookSource then pData.FlipbookSource = freshData.ImgFlipbookSource end
	if freshData.ImgFlipbookMode then pData.FlipbookMode = freshData.ImgFlipbookMode end
	if freshData.ImgFlipbookFramerate then pData.FlipbookFramerate = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.ImgFlipbookFramerate) end
	if freshData.ImgFlipbookReverse ~= nil then pData.FlipbookReverse = freshData.ImgFlipbookReverse end
	if freshData.ImgGridCols then pData.GridCols = freshData.ImgGridCols end
	if freshData.ImgGridRows then pData.GridRows = freshData.ImgGridRows end
	if freshData.SheetSize ~= nil then pData.SheetSize = freshData.SheetSize end
	if freshData.ImageFlipbooks then pData.FlipbookDecals = gatherFlipbookDecals(freshData.ImageFlipbooks) end
	if freshData.ImgTimescale and pData.Graphs then pData.Graphs.Timescale = freshData.ImgTimescale; pData.Seeds.Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(freshData.ImgTimescale) end
end

end

--[[
	InstanceMap: a table keyed by Instances whose entries go when their instance is destroyed.
	A weak-keyed table is no such thing in Roblox: it drops an Instance once no variable holds its
	handle though the instance lives on, and never drops one whose value refers to it (Luau's weak keys
	are not ephemerons). Here a key is held, so a lookup finds the same handle, and the instance's
	Destroying (its own Destroy or an ancestor's) clears the entry.
	  local map = InstanceMap.new()
	  map:get(inst) -> the value or nil
	  map:set(inst, value)       nil clears the entry
	  map:clear()
	An instance dropped without Destroy keeps its entry until cleared: whoever drops one that way clears
	it. Never in the engine step's inner loop: the first set of a key makes a connection.
]]

local InstanceMap = {}
InstanceMap.__index = InstanceMap

function InstanceMap.new()
	return setmetatable({ values = {}, watches = {} }, InstanceMap)
end

function InstanceMap:get(inst)
	return self.values[inst]
end

function InstanceMap:set(inst, value)
	if value == nil then
		local watch = self.watches[inst]
		if watch then
			watch:Disconnect()
		end
		self.values[inst] = nil
		self.watches[inst] = nil
		return
	end
	self.values[inst] = value
	if not self.watches[inst] then
		self.watches[inst] = inst.Destroying:Connect(function()
			self:set(inst, nil)
		end)
	end
end

function InstanceMap:clear()
	for _, watch in pairs(self.watches) do
		watch:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self.values)
	table.clear(self.watches)
end

return InstanceMap

--[[
	Lifecycle mixin  -  cancelAnimation, Disable, SoftDisable, EmitAnimate, EnableEmit, Enable.
	Each EnableEmit bumps the `_emitGen` attribute; its delayed closures stop once it has moved on.
]]

local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local IS_STUDIO = RunService:IsStudio()
-- Selection:Get works only in a plugin.
local IS_PLUGIN = pcall(function() return Selection:Get() end)
-- On clients the loop resumes on PreRender, after attachments have moved this frame, so a Trail's
-- first sample reads the clean spawn pose; servers have only Heartbeat.
local LOOP_YIELD_EVENT = RunService:IsClient() and RunService.PreRender or RunService.Heartbeat
local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local Events = require(script.Parent.Events)
local EvenCycle = require(script.Parent.EvenCycle)
local EngineAttr = require(script.Parent.EngineAttr)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)
local DecalLayersMod = require(script.Parent.DecalLayers)
local MeshFramesMod = require(script.Parent.MeshFrames)
local AtRest = require(script.Parent.AtRest)
local Drive = require(script.Parent.Container.Drive)

return function(Particle)
	-- Cancels an Animate cycle in progress: restores the pose, removes it from ActiveEmits. A Beam
	-- restores from its snapshot.
	local function cancelAnimation(self, item)
		local existing = self.ActiveAnimates[item]
		if not existing then return end
		-- The snapshot first: the other order shows one frame of the last cycle's look at the start pose.
		if (existing.Type == "Beam" or existing.Type == "Highlight" or existing.Type == "TrailEmitter")
			and existing.VisualPart and existing.VisualPart.Parent then
			local snap = existing.BeamSnapshot or existing.HighlightSnapshot or existing.TrailEmitterSnapshot
			if snap then
				pcall(function()
					for name, value in pairs(snap) do existing.VisualPart[name] = value end
				end)
			end
			existing.VisualPart.Enabled = false
		end
		if existing.InitialAnchorCF and existing.VisualPart and existing.VisualPart.Parent then
			if existing.Type == "Model" then
				existing.VisualPart:PivotTo(existing.InitialAnchorCF)
				if existing.InitialScale then
					pcall(function() existing.VisualPart:ScaleTo(existing.InitialScale) end)
				end
			elseif existing.Type ~= "Beam" then
				existing.VisualPart.CFrame = existing.InitialAnchorCF
			end
		end
		-- The live RenderTemplate's Beams and Lights go off with the play (AtRest; mirrors finishAnimate).
		if (existing.Type == "Part" or existing.Type == "Attachment" or existing.Type == "Model") and existing.VisualPart and existing.VisualPart.Parent then
			AtRest.rest(existing.VisualPart)
		end
		-- Part and Attachment hide by Transparency 1, as finishAnimate does.
		if (existing.Type == "Part" or existing.Type == "Attachment") and existing.VisualPart and existing.VisualPart.Parent then
			DecalLayersMod.restore(existing)
			MeshFramesMod.restore(existing)
			pcall(function()
				existing.VisualPart.Transparency = 1
				if existing.HasDecal then
					local d = existing.VisualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
					if d then d.Transparency = 1 end
				end
			end)
		end
		if (existing.Type == "Screen" or existing.Type == "ImageLabel" or existing.Type == "Lightning" or existing.Type == "Rocks" or existing.Type == "Rope") and existing.VisualPart then
			-- Lightning, Rocks and Rope animate a copy: nothing of the source to restore.
			pcall(function() existing.VisualPart:Destroy() end)
			if existing._impactDisk then pcall(function() existing._impactDisk:Destroy() end) end
		end
		self:_reclaimPData(existing)
		for idx = #self.ActiveEmits, 1, -1 do
			if self.ActiveEmits[idx] == existing then
				local n = #self.ActiveEmits
				if idx < n then self.ActiveEmits[idx] = self.ActiveEmits[n] end
				self.ActiveEmits[n] = nil
				break
			end
		end
		self.ActiveAnimates[item] = nil
	end

	-- For Particle:Deactivate.
	function Particle:_cancelAnimation(item)
		cancelAnimation(self, item)
	end

	-- Stops new emission. hard: Animate sources restored now and raw descendants cut off; soft: they
	-- are switched off and live particles finish. cancelAnimation before cfg.Enabled.
	local function haltEmission(self, item, hard)
		if Particle.ActiveLoops[item] then
			task.cancel(Particle.ActiveLoops[item])
			Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = nil
		end
		local chainBucket = Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item]
		if chainBucket then
			for _, t in ipairs(chainBucket) do pcall(task.cancel, t) end
			Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item] = nil
		end
		EngineAttr.write(item, "AnimateLoop", false)
		local gen = (item:GetAttribute("_emitGen") or 0) + 1
		EngineAttr.write(item, "_emitGen", gen)
		if hard then cancelAnimation(self, item) end
		local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
		if config then EngineAttr.write(config, "Enabled", false) end
		EngineAttr.write(item, "_PartIclePlaying", nil)
		-- The even spread's cycle starts over (descendants clear theirs below).
		EvenCycle.clear(self._evenCycleStore, item:GetAttribute("_EvenCycleId") or item)
		for _, desc in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
				if hard then self:Disable(desc) else self:SoftDisable(desc) end
			elseif TypeRegistry.isInsideRenderTemplate(desc, item) then
				-- The RenderTemplate's natives are the copies' template; Transform and AtRest own them.
			elseif desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail") then
				if hard then ParticlesMod.CancelNative(desc) else pcall(function() desc.Enabled = false end) end
			elseif desc:IsA("Beam") or desc:IsA("Highlight") then
				pcall(function() desc.Enabled = false end)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Hard stop: emission and every live copy now. One undo step in Studio.
	function Particle:Disable(item)
		if not item then return end
		-- Inside the step (an event's Module): queued, so the sweep cannot pull entries from under it.
		if self._inStep then
			self._afterStep = self._afterStep or {}
			table.insert(self._afterStep, function() self:Disable(item) end)
			return
		end
		local CHS = IS_PLUGIN and game:GetService("RunService"):IsEdit() and game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService") or nil
		if CHS then CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Disable") end
		haltEmission(self, item, true)
		-- A Reactor's play may be dormant, off the active list: it is put back by name (Reactor/init).
		if Particle._isReactor(item) then self:RestoreReactor(item) end
		-- Copies that became Reactors are on no list the sweep reads (Reactor/HandOver).
		self:_endReacted(item, nil)
		-- Backwards, as removal swaps and pops; _releaseOrDestroy pools what it can.
		local active = self.ActiveEmits
		for idx = #active, 1, -1 do
			local pData = active[idx]
			if pData and pData._sourceItem == item then
				if pData.VisualPart and pData.VisualPart.Parent then
					self:_releaseOrDestroy(pData, pData.VisualPart)
				end
				self:_reclaimPData(pData)
				-- _releaseOrDestroy may already have removed an Animate entry.
				if active[idx] == pData then
					local n = #active
					if idx < n then active[idx] = active[n] end
					active[n] = nil
				end
			end
		end
		-- Lingering copies end early; _lingerCounted guards the count.
		if self._lingerByItem and self._lingerByItem[item] then
			for _, visualPart in ipairs(self._lingerByItem[item]) do
				if visualPart then
					local counted = false
					pcall(function() counted = visualPart:GetAttribute("_lingerCounted") == true end)
					if counted then
						self._lingerVisualCount = math.max(0, (self._lingerVisualCount or 0) - 1)
						EngineAttr.write(visualPart, "_lingerCounted", nil)
					end
					if visualPart.Parent then
						pcall(function() visualPart:Destroy() end)
					end
				end
			end
			self._lingerByItem[item] = nil
		end
		if CHS then CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Disable") end
	end

	-- Soft stop: no new emission; live copies finish their Lifetime.
	function Particle:SoftDisable(item)
		if not item then return end
		local CHS = IS_PLUGIN and game:GetService("RunService"):IsEdit() and game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService") or nil
		if CHS then CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Soft Disable") end
		haltEmission(self, item, false)
		if CHS then CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Soft Disable") end
	end


	-- One Animate cycle: a 3D item animates in place, a screen type plays a single copy.
	function Particle:EmitAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		self:_warnIfNotActivated("EmitAnimate")
		local isCloneAnimate = item:IsA("BlurEffect")
			or item:IsA("BloomEffect")
			or item:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect")
			or item:IsA("Atmosphere")
			or item:IsA("ImageLabel")
			or Particle._isLightning(item)
			or Particle._isCameraShake(item)
			or Particle._isRocks(item)
			or Particle._isRope(item)
			or Particle._isDistortion(item)
		if isCloneAnimate and self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
		cancelAnimation(self, item)
		-- The cap here, not in _registerEmit: Animate writes the live RenderTemplate before registering.
		local cap = self.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES or 1000
		if #self.ActiveEmits + (self._lingerVisualCount or 0) >= cap then
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - (self._capWarnLastAt or 0) >= 1 then
				self._capWarnLastAt = now
				Log.warn(("[Part-Icles] active particle cap (%d) reached  -  new emits skipped (user Module code still runs)."):format(cap))
			end
			return
		end
		-- A Container has no Animate: it would play its real RenderTemplate.
		if Particle._isContainer(item) then self:EmitContainer(item, link, emitCtx)
		-- Nor a Force, which has nothing to play in place.
		elseif Particle._isForce(item) then self:EmitForce(item, link, emitCtx)
		-- Nor has a Matte: its shapes are copies in its layer.
		elseif Particle._isMatte(item) then self:EmitMatte(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif Particle._isReactor(item) then self:EmitReactor(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Beam") then self:EmitBeamAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Trail") and item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties") then self:EmitTrailAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Highlight") then self:EmitHighlightAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Attachment") then self:EmitAttachmentAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Model") then self:EmitModelAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("BlurEffect") then self:EmitBlurAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("BloomEffect") then self:EmitBloomAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then self:EmitColorCorrectionAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Atmosphere") then self:EmitAtmosphereAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("ImageLabel") then self:EmitImageLabelAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif Particle._isLightning(item) then self:EmitLightningAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif Particle._isCameraShake(item) then self:EmitCameraShakeAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif Particle._isRocks(item) then self:EmitRocksAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif Particle._isRope(item) then self:EmitRopeAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif Particle._isDistortion(item) then self:EmitDistortionAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then self:EmitPartAnimate(item, link, emitCtx) end
	end

	-- An emit by EmitCount, EmitDelay and EmitDuration; in Animate, EmitDuration bounds AnimateLoop.
	function Particle:EnableEmit(item, link, emitCtx)
		self:_warnIfNotActivated("EnableEmit")
		local emissionMode = item:GetAttribute('EmissionMode') or "Emit"
		-- No EmitCount means 1; an explicit 0 emits nothing.
		local rawEmitCount = item:GetAttribute('EmitCount')
		local emitCount = rawEmitCount == nil and 1 or rawEmitCount
		-- An event firing its target always emits at least one burst.
		if emitCount <= 0 and emitCtx and emitCtx.EventDriven then emitCount = 1 end
		local emitDelay = item:GetAttribute('EmitDelay') or 0
		local emitDuration = ParticlesMod.parseDuration(item:GetAttribute('EmitDuration')) or 0
		-- Per-play overrides (EmitAt's Count, Delay, Duration) for this call only.
		local overrides = emitCtx and emitCtx.Overrides
		if overrides then
			if overrides.Count ~= nil then emitCount = overrides.Count end
			if overrides.Delay ~= nil then emitDelay = overrides.Delay end
			if overrides.Duration ~= nil then emitDuration = ParticlesMod.parseDuration(overrides.Duration) or 0 end
		end
		-- Animate items at 0 / 0 still go on (AnimateLoop drives them).
		if emissionMode ~= "Animate" and emitCount <= 0 and emitDuration <= 0 then return end

		-- Not serialized by _emitGen: chain-driven, nested (one loop per parent particle, set by
		-- NestedEmit.walk) and instant bursts, which must coexist.
		local isChainDriven = emitCtx and emitCtx.ChainCtx ~= nil
		local isNestedDriven = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive ~= nil
		-- EmitAt plays coexist too, each stopped by its token; Animate keeps one cycle per source.
		local isPlayDriven = emitCtx ~= nil and emitCtx._playToken ~= nil and emissionMode ~= "Animate"
		local skipGenSerialization = isChainDriven or isNestedDriven or isPlayDriven or emitDuration <= 0
		-- A top-level emit stamps _EvenCycleId on it and its nested emitters, so copies share one counter.
		if not (isChainDriven or isNestedDriven) then EvenCycle.ensureIds(item) end
		local startGen
		if not skipGenSerialization then
			startGen = (item:GetAttribute("_emitGen") or 0) + 1
			EngineAttr.write(item, "_emitGen", startGen)
		end
		-- Closures past an Activate or Deactivate stop.
		local engineGen = self._engineGen or 0
		local function genStillCurrent()
			if self.Connection == nil then return false end
			if (self._engineGen or 0) ~= engineGen then return false end
			if not item.Parent then return false end
			if not skipGenSerialization and (item:GetAttribute("_emitGen") or 0) ~= startGen then
				return false
			end
			-- The parent particle ended.
			if emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive and not emitCtx._parentAlive[1] then return false end
			-- PlayHandle:Disable.
			if emitCtx and emitCtx._playToken and emitCtx._playToken.Alive == false then return false end
			return true
		end

		if emissionMode == "Animate" then
			local function doAnimate()
				if not genStillCurrent() then return end
				if emitDuration > 0 then
					EngineAttr.write(item, "AnimateLoop", true)
					task.delay(emitDuration, function()
						-- Its own guard: the window must close even after a nested parent died, or AnimateLoop stays on.
						if self.Connection == nil or (self._engineGen or 0) ~= engineGen or not item.Parent then return end
						if not skipGenSerialization and (item:GetAttribute("_emitGen") or 0) ~= startGen then return end
						if item:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") then EngineAttr.write(item, "AnimateLoop", false) end
					end)
				end
				self:EmitAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
			end
			if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doAnimate) else doAnimate() end
			return
		end

		local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)

		local function doEmit()
			if not genStillCurrent() then return end
			-- The cycle advances once per burst, offsetting every particle's even spread (_EvenCycleId's counter).
			local hasPosEven, hasRotEven = EvenCycle.evenFlags(config)
			local cyPI, cyPN, cyRI, cyRN = 1, 0, 1, 0
			if hasPosEven or hasRotEven then
				local cycleKey = item:GetAttribute("_EvenCycleId") or item
				local currentRate = (config and config:GetAttribute("Rate")) or 10
				cyPI, cyPN, cyRI, cyRN = EvenCycle.advance(self._evenCycleStore, cycleKey, config, currentRate, hasPosEven, hasRotEven)
			end
			for i = 1, emitCount do
				self:Emit(item, link, Events.withEvenOffset(emitCtx, i, emitCount, cyPI, cyPN, cyRI, cyRN))
			end
			if emitDuration > 0 then
				if isChainDriven or isNestedDriven or isPlayDriven then
					-- Chain, nested or play driven: a parallel loop; cfg.Enabled (the user's switch) is left alone.
					self:Enable(item, link, emitDuration, emitCtx)
				else
					-- A user's duration emit: Enabled on, as a normal Enable; _PartIclePlaying stops another runtime
					-- copy auto-enabling it.
					EngineAttr.write(item, "_PartIclePlaying", true)
					if config then EngineAttr.write(config, "Enabled", true) end
					self:Enable(item, link, emitDuration, emitCtx)
					task.delay(emitDuration, function()
						if not genStillCurrent() then return end
						if config and config.Parent then EngineAttr.write(config, "Enabled", false) end
						EngineAttr.write(item, "_PartIclePlaying", nil)
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEmit) else doEmit() end
	end

	-- Emits continuously until the duration ends, Enabled goes off, the parent ends or the engine
	-- restarts. Animate sets AnimateLoop and plays EmitAnimate.
	function Particle:Enable(item, link, duration, emitCtx)
		self:_warnIfNotActivated("Enable")
		local data = self:GetData(item)
		if not data then return end
		local emissionMode = item:GetAttribute('EmissionMode') or "Emit"
		if emissionMode == "Animate" then
			EngineAttr.write(item, "AnimateLoop", true)
			self:EmitAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
			return
		end
		local loopDuration = duration or math.huge
		local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
		-- Chain and nested loops run in parallel (their own bucket); a user's loop replaces the last.
		local isChainDriven = emitCtx and emitCtx.ChainCtx ~= nil
		local isNestedDriven = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive ~= nil
		-- An EmitAt play runs in parallel too; its PlayHandle stops it (token.Alive, token.Loops).
		local playToken = emitCtx and emitCtx._playToken
		local isPlayDriven = playToken ~= nil
		local isParallel = isChainDriven or isNestedDriven or isPlayDriven
		local engineGenAtStart = self._engineGen or 0
		local function loopBody()
			local startTime = os.clock()
			local emitAccum = 0 -- sub-frame Rate carry
			-- The even spread's cycle, shared with bursts and nested emits by _EvenCycleId; reset by Disable.
			-- Its sign is the direction.
			local cycleKey = item:GetAttribute("_EvenCycleId") or item
			while true do
				if isParallel and (self._engineGen or 0) ~= engineGenAtStart then break end
				-- This parent particle ended (each parent's emit has its own _parentAlive).
				if isNestedDriven and emitCtx._parentAlive and not emitCtx._parentAlive[1] then break end
				if isPlayDriven and not playToken.Alive then break end
				if not item or not item.Parent then
					if not isParallel then Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = nil end; break
				end
				if os.clock() - startTime >= loopDuration then
					if not isParallel then Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = nil end; break
				end
				if not isParallel and not data.CheckEnabled() then
					Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = nil; break
				end
				local dt = LOOP_YIELD_EVENT:Wait()
				-- After the yield the parent or the engine may have ended.
				if isParallel and (self._engineGen or 0) ~= engineGenAtStart then break end
				if isNestedDriven and emitCtx._parentAlive and not emitCtx._parentAlive[1] then break end
				if isPlayDriven and not playToken.Alive then break end
				-- Paused while Studio is out of focus; in a game this always passes.
				if IS_STUDIO and IS_PLUGIN and not Particle._focused then
					local sel = Selection:Get()
					if #sel == 0 or (Particle._unfocusedAt > 0 and os.clock() - Particle._unfocusedAt > 600) then emitAccum = 0; continue end
				end
				-- Under a Container: its Rate graph thins the stream, its Timescale runs the stream's clock
				-- (Container/Drive.stream).
				local currentRate, streamDt = Drive.stream(emitCtx and emitCtx._containerDrive, config and config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10, dt)
				if currentRate <= 0 then emitAccum = 0; continue end
				local interval = 1 / currentRate
				emitAccum = emitAccum + streamDt
				local hasPosEven = (data.PosXEven or data.PosYEven or data.PosZEven) == true
				local hasRotEven = (data.RotXEven or data.RotYEven or data.RotZEven) == true
				-- Emit Type Burst (EmitMode, as on a native emitter): each interval emits EmitCount; read every
				-- frame, so an edit shows at once.
				local burstCount = 1
				if item:GetAttribute("EmitMode") == "Burst" then
					burstCount = math.max(tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitCount")) or 1, 1)
				end
				while emitAccum >= interval do
					emitAccum = emitAccum - interval
					if burstCount > 1 then
						local cyPI, cyPN, cyRI, cyRN = 1, 0, 1, 0
						if hasPosEven or hasRotEven then
							cyPI, cyPN, cyRI, cyRN = EvenCycle.advance(self._evenCycleStore, cycleKey, config, currentRate, hasPosEven, hasRotEven)
						end
						for burstIndex = 1, burstCount do
							self:Emit(item, link, Events.withEvenOffset(emitCtx, burstIndex, burstCount, cyPI, cyPN, cyRI, cyRN))
						end
					elseif hasPosEven or hasRotEven then
						-- One particle per emission: the cycle is pure offset.
						local cyPI, cyPN, cyRI, cyRN = EvenCycle.advance(self._evenCycleStore, cycleKey, config, currentRate, hasPosEven, hasRotEven)
						self:Emit(item, link, Events.withEvenOffset(emitCtx, 1, 1, cyPI, cyPN, cyRI, cyRN))
					else
						self:Emit(item, link, emitCtx)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if isParallel then
			-- One bucket per item so Disable can cancel it; the task removes its entry when done.
			local chainTask = task.spawn(function()
				loopBody()
				local selfThread = coroutine.running()
				local bucket = Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item]
				if not bucket then return end
				for i = #bucket, 1, -1 do
					if bucket[i] == selfThread then table.remove(bucket, i); break end
				end
				if #bucket == 0 then Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item] = nil end
			end)
			local bucket = Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item]
			if not bucket then bucket = {}; Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item] = bucket end
			table.insert(bucket, chainTask)
			-- So PlayHandle:Disable / SoftDisable cancel exactly this task.
			if isPlayDriven then table.insert(playToken.Loops, chainTask) end
		else
			if Particle.ActiveLoops[item] then task.cancel(Particle.ActiveLoops[item]) end
			Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = task.spawn(loopBody)
		end
	end




	-- Whether the engine session is the same (delayed closures stop otherwise).
	function Particle:_makeAliveCheck()
		local engineGen = self._engineGen or 0
		return function()
			return self.Connection ~= nil and (self._engineGen or 0) == engineGen
		end
	end

	-- An AnimateLoop restart: OnHit seeded again, OnEmit fired (EmitIndex nil).
	function Particle:_fireAnimateCycleRestartEvents(pData)
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnHit then
			pData.LastHitCheckPos = Events.getWorldPosition(pData)
			pData.LastHitCheckTime = nil
		end
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnEmit then
			local payload = Events.makePayload(self, pData, "OnEmit", { ChainCtx = pData.EventChainCtx, EmitIndex = nil })
			Events.fire(self, pData, "OnEmit", pData.EventChainCtx, payload)
		end
	end

	-- Kill only flags; the step's death branch removes or restores (PartLife 0: at once). Animate also
	-- switches off AnimateLoop and Enabled so the death goes to the animate finish.
	function Particle:_killParticle(pData, opts)
		opts = opts or {}
		pData._killedManually = true
		pData._fireOnDeathOverride = opts.fireOnDeath == true
		pData._forceDead = true
		pData.PartLife = 0
		if pData.IsAnimate then
			local source = pData._sourceItem
			if source then
				pcall(function()
					EngineAttr.write(source, "AnimateLoop", false)
					-- Enabled lives on the Configuration.
					local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(source)
					if cfg then EngineAttr.write(cfg, "Enabled", false) end
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

--[[
	LifecycleRelease Mixin  -  end-of-life helpers shared by Engine reclaim paths and finishAnimate:
	_fireOnDeath / _fireOnDestruction (event dispatch) and _releaseOrDestroy (pool release vs Destroy).
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)
local Events = require(script.Parent.Events)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)
local NestedScale = require(script.Parent.NestedScale)

return function(Particle)

	-- Animate pData whose VisualPart IS the source's live RenderTemplate. Every destroy path
	-- (Deactivate, cap-reject, PlayHandle / Disable sweeps) must restore it, never Destroy it.
	function Particle:_isLiveRTAnimate(pData)
		if not pData.IsAnimate then return false end
		local t = pData.Type
		return t == "Part" or t == "Attachment" or t == "Beam" or t == "Model" or t == "Highlight" or t == "TrailEmitter"
	end

	-- Bookkeeping every ActiveEmits removal route runs (Engine death / one-shot finish / Deactivate,
	-- Disable sweep, PlayHandle:Disable, cancelAnimation, cap-reject): flips the nested-alive flag so
	-- pending nested closures and duration loops stop. Callers still pop the entry from ActiveEmits.
	function Particle:_reclaimPData(pData)
		if pData._nestedAlive then pData._nestedAlive[1] = false end
		-- The play has ended (RollLock: a copy the pool keeps lends no spin from it).
		pData._reclaimed = true
		-- A play that keeps state outside its pData lets go of it here (Force/init: the Registry
		-- record; Reactor/HandOver: a mesh's place on the list of plays that may react).
		if pData._onReclaim then pData._onReclaim(pData) end
	end

	-- OnDeath fire helper; manual Kill suppresses unless fireOnDeath=true.
	function Particle:_fireOnDeath(pData)
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnDeath
			and (not pData._killedManually or pData._fireOnDeathOverride) then
			Events.fire(self, pData, "OnDeath", pData.EventChainCtx, nil)
		end
	end

	function Particle:_fireOnDestruction(pData, visualPart)
		if not (pData.Events and pData.Events.OnDestruction) then return end
		-- Clone-backed types need the visual still parented; VisualPart-less types (CameraShake,
		-- Distortion) resolve their origin through Events.getWorldCF instead.
		local hasOrigin = (visualPart and visualPart.Parent) or (not visualPart and Events.getWorldCF(pData) ~= nil)
		if hasOrigin then
			Events.fire(self, pData, "OnDestruction", pData.EventChainCtx, nil)
		end
	end

	-- Releases the visual to the pool when eligible, else Destroy. Animate visuals never pool, nor
	-- does a copy whose emitters a Container wrote to (pData._noPool, Container/Drive.adopt). The
	-- carrier (if any) is released only after the visual is destroyed or re-parented into the pool:
	-- destroying the carrier first would take a pooled child with it.
	function Particle:_releaseOrDestroy(pData, visualPart)
		self:_releaseVisual(pData, visualPart)
		if pData._carrier then
			VisualHost.releaseCarrier(pData._carrier)
			pData._carrier = nil
		end
	end

	function Particle:_releaseVisual(pData, visualPart)
		-- Fan-out clones (Lightning per-segment lights) always destroy, never pool. Runs before the early
		-- returns so a dead visualPart still sweeps its extras.
		if pData._extraLights then
			for _, extraLight in ipairs(pData._extraLights) do
				pcall(function() extraLight:Destroy() end)
			end
			pData._extraLights = nil
		end
		if pData._impactDisk then
			pcall(function() pData._impactDisk:Destroy() end)
			pData._impactDisk = nil
		end
		if self:_isLiveRTAnimate(pData) then
			if pData.AnimateItem then self:_cancelAnimation(pData.AnimateItem) end
			return
		end
		if not visualPart then return end
		if not visualPart.Parent then return end
		if pData.IsAnimate or pData._noPool or not pData._sourceRT or not pData._poolKind then
			Pool.dropCloneMap(visualPart)
			pcall(function() visualPart:Destroy() end)
			return
		end
		-- A pooled copy goes back as it was copied (NestedScale: its attachments and beams).
		if pData._scaledContent then NestedScale.restore(pData._scaledContent) end
		-- Live Rate read so pool cap tracks emitter rate.
		local rate
		local source = pData._sourceItem
		if source and source.Parent then
			local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(source)
			if cfg then rate = cfg:GetAttribute("Rate") end
		end
		Pool.release(visualPart, pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind, rate)
	end

end
