--[[
	Lightning mixin  -  Emit, Animate and Update for part-based lightning. The visual is a Model of
	segment parts cloned from the RenderTemplate; BoltGen rolls the geometry at JitterRate, and each
	frame only steps transparency, colour and the tip's reveal. Buffers live on a per-model rig, so a
	pooled bolt allocates nothing. Endpoints: "Point" (to the Target, read live) or "Directional"
	(EmissionDirection and SpreadAngle for Length). Animate plays a copy; the source is never written.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local ContainerFade = require(script.Parent.Container.Fade)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.AxisLinks)
local NestedEmit = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local TurbulenceMod = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local EventsMod = require(script.Parent.Events)
local BoltGen = require(script.BoltGen)

local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

local RigMod = require(script.Rig)
local buildRig = RigMod.buildRig
local acquireBolt = RigMod.acquireBolt
local layoutFor = RigMod.layoutFor
local flushCFrames = RigMod.flushCFrames
local FAR_CFRAME = RigMod.FAR_CFRAME

-- Fresh rolls a frame under frame pressure; the rest wait a frame (pData._rollPending). Calm scenes
-- are untouched.
local ROLL_BUDGET = 8
local PRESSURE_ON = 1 / 40
local PRESSURE_OFF = 1 / 55
local _frameStamp = -1
local _rollsUsed = 0
local _budgetActive = false
local _calmFrames = 0

return function(Particle)

-- Shared by the Emit and EmitAnimate dispatch.
function Particle._isLightning(item)
	return item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsLightning") == true
end

local EndpointsMod = require(script.Endpoints)
local ImpactDisk = require(script.ImpactDisk)
local sampleShape = EndpointsMod.sampleShape
local resolveEndpoints = EndpointsMod.resolveEndpoints

-- Writes the planned Sizes (BoltGen.planSizes picks the parts that changed); every Size write goes
-- through here or the plan's caches lie.
local function writeSizes(rig, thick, force)
	local writes = BoltGen.planSizes(rig, thick, force)
	for k = 1, writes do
		local i = rig.sizeWriteIdx[k]
		local w = math.max(0.05, thick * rig.widthScale[i] * rig.taper[i])
		rig.parts[i].Size = Vector3.new(w, w, rig.segLen[i])
	end
end

-- One roll: endpoints, BoltGen, scroll overlay, sizes.
local function applyRoll(pData, atEmit)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local startCF, startPos, endPos = resolveEndpoints(pData)
	pData._totalLen = BoltGen.roll(rig, pData, startPos, endPos, FAR_CFRAME)
	if pData._shapeMode ~= "Jitter" then
		BoltGen.applyScroll(rig, pData, pData._scrollPhase or 0)
		BoltGen.applyScrollForks(rig, pData, pData._scrollPhase or 0)
	end
	RigMod.applyTaper(rig, pData.Graphs.ThicknessProfile, pData.Seeds.ThicknessProfile, pData._totalLen)
	-- Slots coming back from parked take their cached look again (not at emit: writeVisuals covers it).
	local newlyLive = BoltGen.diffLive(rig)
	local gradient = pData.Graphs.Gradient
	if not atEmit and newlyLive > 0 then
		local trans = pData._curShownTrans
		local color = not gradient and pData._curColor or nil
		for k = 1, newlyLive do
			local idx = rig.newlyLiveIdx[k]
			local seg = rig.parts[idx]
			if trans then seg.Transparency = trans end
			if color then seg.Color = color end
			local decal = rig.decals[idx]
			if decal then
				if trans then decal.Transparency = trans end
				if color then decal.Color3 = color end
			end
		end
	end
	-- Spatial Gradient: each live part's colour at its arc position, now; with a still Color the
	-- visuals are written once, so rolled arcs would keep stale colours.
	if gradient and not pData.SkipColor then
		local invReveal = 1 / math.max(rig.maxReveal or 0, 1e-4)
		local tint = pData._curTint
		for i = 1, rig.partCount do
			if rig.prevLive[i] then
				local arcFrac = math.clamp((rig.revealDist[i] + rig.segLen[i] * 0.5) * invReveal, 0, 1)
				local g = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(arcFrac, gradient)
				rig.gradColor[i] = g
				if not atEmit then
					local c = tint
						and Color3.new(math.min(g.R * tint.R, 1), math.min(g.G * tint.G, 1), math.min(g.B * tint.B, 1))
						or g
					rig.parts[i].Color = c
					local decal = rig.decals[i]
					if decal then decal.Color3 = c end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	writeSizes(rig, pData._curThick or 0.15, atEmit)
	pcall(function() pData.VisualPart.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(startPos) * startCF.Rotation end)
	flushCFrames(pData, atEmit)
	if pData._impactDisk then ImpactDisk.place(pData, startPos, endPos) end
end

-- Visuals at a step: graphs sampled, then written; parked slots skip (applyRoll restores them).
local function writeVisuals(pData, t)
	local graphs, seeds = pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds
	local trans = graphs.Transparency and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Transparency, seeds.Transparency) or 0
	if pData.SkipTransparency then trans = pData._curTrans or trans end
	local bright = graphs.Brightness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Brightness, seeds.Brightness) or 1
	local color
	if graphs.Color and not pData.SkipColor then
		local c = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.Color)
		color = Color3.new(math.min(c.R * bright, 1), math.min(c.G * bright, 1), math.min(c.B * bright, 1))
	end
	local thick = graphs.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Thickness, seeds.Thickness)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local thickChanged = thick and thick ~= pData._curThick
	if thick then pData._curThick = thick end
	pData._curTrans = trans
	-- A Container's Transparency fades the bolt on top of its own.
	local shown = ContainerFade.number(trans, ContainerFade.of(pData._drive))
	pData._curShownTrans = shown
	pData._curBright = bright
	if color then
		pData._curColor = color
		-- For the Gradient's compose in applyRoll.
		pData._curTint = color
	end
	local gradient = graphs.Gradient
	for i = 1, rig.partCount do
		if rig.prevLive[i] then
			local seg = rig.parts[i]
			seg.Transparency = shown
			local decal = rig.decals[i]
			if decal then decal.Transparency = shown end
			if color then
				local c = color
				if gradient then
					local g = rig.gradColor[i]
					if g then
						c = Color3.new(math.min(g.R * color.R, 1), math.min(g.G * color.G, 1), math.min(g.B * color.B, 1))
					end
				end
				seg.Color = c
				if decal then decal.Color3 = c end
			end
		end
	end
	if thickChanged then
		writeSizes(rig, thick, false)
	end
	if pData._impactDisk then ImpactDisk.write(pData, t) end
end

local PDataBuilder = require(script.PDataBuilder)
local buildPData = PDataBuilder.build

-- Seek mode's rays: OnHit's filter, the engine's folders left out, CanCollide respected.
local function buildSeekParams(self, pData)
	if pData._endpointMode ~= "Seek" then return end
	local p = EventsMod.makeHitParams(pData)
	p.RespectCanCollide = true
	pcall(function()
		p:AddToFilter(self:GetFolder())
		p:AddToFilter(self:GetPoolFolder())
	end)
	pData._seekRayFn = function(origin, disp)
		return workspace:Raycast(origin, disp, p)
	end
end

-- OnHit at each strike point found (Seek mode); Events.reserveFrameFire limits retarget spam.
local function fireSeekHit(self, pData)
	if not pData._seekNewHit then return end
	-- A glide holds the fire until the strike point arrives.
	if not EndpointsMod.glideArrived(pData) then return end
	pData._seekNewHit = nil
	if not (pData.Events and pData.Events.OnHit and pData._seekHit) then return end
	local hit = pData._seekHit
	local payload = EventsMod.makePayload(self, pData, "OnHit", nil)
	payload.HitInstance = hit.Instance
	payload.Other = hit.Instance
	payload.HitPosition = hit.Position
	payload.HitNormal = hit.Normal
	EventsMod.fire(self, pData, "OnHit", pData.EventChainCtx, payload)
end

-- One bolt.
function Particle:EmitLightning(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local model, rig = acquireBolt(data)
	local pData = buildPData(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	-- Nested: the bolt's origin rides the emitted parent's live CFrame.
	pData._parentLink = link
	-- In a Matte: the segments are windows in its layer (Matte/init).
	self:_matteCarry(emitCtx, pData, rig.parts, "Spine", rig.mainSegs)

	-- An event's origin is the bolt's start for its whole life.
	if emitCtx then
		local originCF
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then originCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		originCF = originCF or emitCtx.EventOriginCF
		if originCF then
			pData._startCFOverride = (emitCtx.UseFullOrigin and originCF)
				or CFrame.new(originCF.Position) * item.CFrame.Rotation
		end
	end

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	if data.Pool ~= false then
		pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Lightning"
	end

	-- Frame 0: thickness, a roll (before parenting: plain CFrame writes), visuals.
	pData._curThick = data.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Thickness, pData.Seeds.Thickness) or 0.15
	buildSeekParams(self, pData)
	-- An emit's roll never waits but counts against the budget.
	_rollsUsed += 1
	applyRoll(pData, true)
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)

	model.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()
	ImpactDisk.attach(self, pData, data)
	Pool.restoreTrails(model, "Lightning")
	ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(model, self:_makeAliveCheck())

	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, model, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx)
	fireSeekHit(self, pData)
end

-- Animate: one lasting bolt per source, a copy.
function Particle:EmitLightningAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local model, rig = buildRig(data)
	model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	local pData = buildPData(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	pData._parentLink = link
	pData.IsAnimate = true
	pData.AnimateItem = item

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	pData._curThick = data.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Thickness, pData.Seeds.Thickness) or 0.15
	buildSeekParams(self, pData)
	-- An emit's roll never waits but counts against the budget.
	_rollsUsed += 1
	applyRoll(pData, true)
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)

	model.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()
	ImpactDisk.attach(self, pData, data)
	ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(model, self:_makeAliveCheck())

	self.ActiveAnimates[item] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, model, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx)
	fireSeekHit(self, pData)
end

-- Per frame; an idle frame is a few compares and allocates nothing.
function Particle:UpdateLightning(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- The signed timescale header, as in UpdateHighlight.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local prevEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = prevEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff

	local model = pData.VisualPart
	if not model or not model.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local isDying = real_i >= 1 and (newEff >= lifeTime or newEff <= 0)

	local rig = pData._rig

	-- The first bolt of a frame resets the budget and judges the pressure (two calm frames to relax).
	if currentTime ~= _frameStamp then
		_frameStamp = currentTime
		_rollsUsed = 0
		if dt > PRESSURE_ON then
			_budgetActive = true
			_calmFrames = 0
		elseif _budgetActive then
			if dt < PRESSURE_OFF then
				_calmFrames += 1
				if _calmFrames >= 2 then
					_budgetActive = false
				end
			else
				_calmFrames = 0
			end
		end
	end

	-- No geometry on the death frame; the last keyframe still writes, for a lingering bolt.
	if not isDying then
		-- Origin motion: Speed (drag-damped), Acceleration and PosOffset, picked up at the next roll. By the
		-- clamped effective time, so it stops when the clock pins.
		local mdt = newEff - prevEff
		if pData._hasMotion and mdt ~= 0 then
			local li = math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1)
			local sp = pData.Graphs.Speed and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed) or 0
			if pData._drag ~= 0 then sp = sp * math.exp(-pData._drag * newEff) end
			pData._motionAccelVel = pData._motionAccelVel + pData._accel * mdt
			pData._motionOffset = pData._motionOffset
				+ (pData._lastDirWorld or Vector3.zero) * (sp * mdt)
				+ pData._motionAccelVel * mdt
		end
		if pData._hasDisp then
			local li = math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1)
			local ox = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
			local oy = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
			local oz = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
			pData._dispRaw = Vector3.new(ox, oy, oz)
		end
		if pData._hasTurb then
			local li = math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1)
			pData._turbRaw = TurbulenceMod.sampleRaw(pData.Graphs.Turbulence, pData.Seeds.Turbulence,
				pData._turbSeed, pData._turbFreq, lifeTime, li)
		end
		-- A roll the budget held last frame goes now, past the cap; dropped on a death frame.
		if pData._rollPending and pData._rollPendingStamp ~= currentTime then
			pData._rollPending = nil
			pData._rollPendingStamp = nil
			pData._jitterAccum = 0
			_rollsUsed += 1
			applyRoll(pData, false)
			fireSeekHit(self, pData)
		end

		-- Seek glide: the strike point moves at RetargetSpeed; a bolt with no jitter rolls here to show it.
		if EndpointsMod.glideStep(pData, math.abs(mdt)) and pData._jitterInterval == math.huge then
			if _budgetActive and _rollsUsed >= ROLL_BUDGET then
				pData._rollPending = true
				pData._rollPendingStamp = currentTime
			else
				_rollsUsed += 1
				applyRoll(pData, false)
				fireSeekHit(self, pData)
			end
		end

		-- Jitter rolls at JitterRate (reversed time too); a hitch rolls once, never a burst.
		pData._jitterAccum += math.abs(dtTs)
		if pData._jitterAccum >= pData._jitterInterval and not pData._rollPending then
			if _budgetActive and _rollsUsed >= ROLL_BUDGET then
				pData._rollPending = true
				pData._rollPendingStamp = currentTime
			else
				pData._jitterAccum = 0
				_rollsUsed += 1
				applyRoll(pData, false)
				fireSeekHit(self, pData)
			end
		end

		-- Tip reveal (GrowthSpeed), by effective time so it reverses.
		if pData._lSpeed ~= 0 then
			local tip = math.abs(pData._lSpeed) * newEff
			if tip ~= pData._tipDist then
				pData._tipDist = tip
				if pData._growReversed then
					if pData._shapeMode == "Jitter" then
						flushCFrames(pData, false)
					end
				elseif pData._shapeMode == "Jitter" then
					local order, rd, wcf, rcf = rig.revealOrder, rig.revealDist, rig.writeCFs, rig.rollCFs
					local ptr = pData._revealPtr
					local dirty = false
					while ptr < rig.partCount and rd[order[ptr + 1]] <= tip do
						ptr += 1
						local idx = order[ptr]
						wcf[idx] = rcf[idx]
						dirty = true
					end
					while ptr > 0 and rd[order[ptr]] > tip do
						local idx = order[ptr]
						wcf[idx] = FAR_CFRAME
						dirty = true
						ptr -= 1
					end
					pData._revealPtr = ptr
					if dirty then
						workspace:BulkMoveTo(rig.parts, rig.writeCFs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- Scroll modes: the Perlin wave's phase advances and the main segments are written.
		if pData._shapeMode ~= "Jitter" then
			pData._scrollPhase += pData._scrollSpeed * (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
			BoltGen.applyScroll(rig, pData, pData._scrollPhase)
			BoltGen.applyScrollForks(rig, pData, pData._scrollPhase)
			-- Scroll never changes which slots live.
			writeSizes(rig, pData._curThick or 0.15, false)
			flushCFrames(pData, false)
		end
	end

	local targetStep = math.floor(math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1) * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		writeVisuals(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	end

	return isDying
end

-- An AnimateLoop cycle: settings read again, spread and length rolled, growth and jitter reset;
-- the rig rebuilt when the part count changed.
function Particle:_refreshLightningAnimate(pData, freshData)
	-- A bolt never follows by LinkTrack: its origin rides _userLink through Endpoints.
	pData.Link = nil
	pData._userLink = freshData.Link
	pData._originPivotRot = nil
	pData._originLinkCF = nil
	pData._endpointMode = freshData.TargetMode == "Seek" and "Seek"
		or ((freshData.TargetMode == "Point" and freshData.Target and freshData.Target.Parent) and "Point" or "Directional")
	pData._target = freshData.Target
	-- Seek: the radius rolled again and the strike found again each cycle.
	pData._seekRadius = math.max(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.SeekRadius), 1)
	pData._seekRetarget = freshData.SeekRetarget == true
	pData._seekBias = math.clamp(freshData.SeekBias or 0, 0, 1)
	pData._retargetSpeed = math.max(freshData.RetargetSpeed or 0, 0)
	pData._seekHit = nil
	pData._seekFallbackDir = nil
	pData._seekNewHit = nil
	pData._seekCurrentPos = nil
	pData._seekGoalPos = nil
	buildSeekParams(self, pData)
	pData._length = math.max(0.1, RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.Length))
	pData._amplitude = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.Amplitude)
	pData._decay = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.AmplitudeDecay)
	pData._forkChance = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.ForkChance)
	pData._forkDepth = math.floor(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.ForkDepth) + 0.5)
	pData._forkLenScale = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.ForkLengthScale)
	pData._sag = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.Sag)
	pData._sagShape = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.SagShape)
	pData._shapeMode = freshData.ShapeMode or "Jitter"
	pData._scrollSpeed = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.ScrollSpeed)
	pData._waves = math.max(0.25, RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.Waves))
	pData._scrollPhase = 0
	pData._noiseSeedA = math.random() * 1000
	pData._noiseSeedB = 500 + math.random() * 1000
	local jitterHz = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.JitterRate)
	pData._jitterInterval = jitterHz > 0 and 1 / jitterHz or math.huge
	pData._jitterAccum = 0
	local growthSpeed = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.GrowthSpeed)
	pData._lSpeed = growthSpeed
	pData._growReversed = growthSpeed < 0
	pData._tipDist = 0
	pData._revealPtr = 0
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[freshData.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
	local localAxis = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	local spread = freshData.SpreadAngle or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(freshData, freshData.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, nil)
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(freshData.RotOrder or "Global", rotS.RotX or 0, rotS.RotY or 0, rotS.RotZ or 0)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, localAxis)
	if freshData.DirMode == "Local" then cf = cf * rotXYZ end
	if spread.X > 0 or spread.Y > 0 then
		cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(
			math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.X),
			math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.Y), 0)
	end
	pData._dirLocalVec = cf.LookVector
	pData._dirGlobal = freshData.DirMode == "Global"
	pData._originRot = rotXYZ
	local posS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(freshData, freshData.AxisLinks, {"PosX","PosY","PosZ"}, RangeMod, nil)
	local px, py, pz = posS.PosX or 0, posS.PosY or 0, posS.PosZ or 0
	if px ~= 0 or py ~= 0 or pz ~= 0 then
		pData._originOffset = Vector3.new(px, py, pz)
		pData._originOffsetGlobal = freshData.PosMode == "Global"
	else
		pData._originOffset = nil
	end
	-- Origin motion starts over each cycle.
	pData._accel = freshData.Acceleration or Vector3.zero
	pData._drag = freshData.Drag or 0
	pData._dispMode = freshData.DisplacementMode or "Global"
	pData._motionOffset = Vector3.zero
	pData._motionAccelVel = Vector3.zero
	pData._dispRaw = nil
	pData._hasMotion = PDataBuilder.liveGraph(freshData.Speed) ~= nil or pData._accel.Magnitude > 0
	pData._hasDisp = PDataBuilder.liveGraph(freshData.PosOffsetX) ~= nil
		or PDataBuilder.liveGraph(freshData.PosOffsetY) ~= nil
		or PDataBuilder.liveGraph(freshData.PosOffsetZ) ~= nil
	-- Gradient, Taper and Turbulence read again; a new noise seed per cycle.
	pData.Graphs.Gradient = PDataBuilder.liveColor(freshData.Gradient)
	pData.Graphs.ThicknessProfile = PDataBuilder.liveProfile(freshData.ThicknessProfile)
	pData.Seeds.ThicknessProfile = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(pData.Graphs.ThicknessProfile)
	pData.Graphs.Turbulence = TurbulenceMod.isLive(freshData.Turbulence)
	pData._hasTurb = pData.Graphs.Turbulence ~= nil
	pData._turbFreq = freshData.TurbulenceFrequency or 1
	pData._turbSeed = math.random() * 997 + 0.5
	pData._turbRaw = nil
	sampleShape(pData, freshData, pData.AnimateItem)

	local expected = layoutFor(freshData)
	if expected ~= pData._rig.partCount and freshData.RenderTemplate then
		local oldModel = pData.VisualPart
		local parent = oldModel and oldModel.Parent
		local model, rig = buildRig(freshData)
		model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
		pData.VisualPart = model
		pData._rig = rig
		model.Parent = parent or self:GetFolder()
		if oldModel then pcall(function() oldModel:Destroy() end) end
	end
	-- After any rig rebuild, so the clamp sees the current segments.
	pData._segCount = math.clamp(math.floor(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.SegmentCount) + 0.5), 2, pData._rig.mainSegs)

	pData._curThick = freshData.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, freshData.Thickness, pData.Seeds.Thickness) or pData._curThick
	ImpactDisk.refresh(self, pData, freshData)
	-- A held roll from the old cycle is dropped.
	pData._rollPending = nil
	pData._rollPendingStamp = nil
	_rollsUsed += 1
	applyRoll(pData, false)
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)
	fireSeekHit(self, pData)
end

end

--[[
	BoltGen: pure lightning-bolt geometry, no engine or pool knowledge.
	Midpoint displacement over caller-owned buffers (the rig arrays from Lightning/init.buildRig),
	so a roll creates no tables. Unused fork slots park at farCF with revealDist = math.huge.
]]

local BoltGen = {}

local FORK_MIN_ANGLE = math.rad(15)
local FORK_MAX_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
local MIN_SEG_LEN = 0.05

-- Part-count layout for a config; forkSlots is clamped so the total stays <= maxParts.
-- Slot depths are fixed by position: first half depth 1, the rest depth 2.
function BoltGen.layout(segmentCount, forkDepth, forkChance, maxParts)
	local mainSegs = math.clamp(math.floor(segmentCount or 12), 2, maxParts)
	local forkSlots = 0
	local forkSegs = math.max(2, math.floor(mainSegs / 2))
	-- Matches PDataBuilder's round-to-nearest on the per-bolt roll.
	if (forkDepth or 0) >= 0.5 and (forkChance or 0) > 0 then
		local remaining = maxParts - mainSegs
		-- Shrink the per-fork resolution before giving up slots when Segments leaves little budget.
		if remaining >= 4 and math.floor(remaining / forkSegs) < 2 then
			forkSegs = math.max(4, math.min(forkSegs, math.floor(remaining / 2)))
		end
		forkSlots = math.min(6, math.floor(remaining / forkSegs))
		if forkSlots < 0 then forkSlots = 0 end
	end
	return mainSegs + forkSlots * forkSegs, mainSegs, forkSegs, forkSlots
end

-- Orthonormal basis perpendicular to dir; a degenerate dir falls back to world axes.
function BoltGen.basis(dir)
	if dir.Magnitude < 1e-4 then return Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.zAxis end
	local unit = dir.Unit
	local ref = math.abs(unit.Y) < 0.99 and Vector3.yAxis or Vector3.xAxis
	local u = unit:Cross(ref).Unit
	local v = unit:Cross(u)
	return u, v
end

-- Recursive midpoint displacement over pts[lo..hi] (endpoints set); amplitude decays per level.
local function displace(pts, lo, hi, amp, decay, u, v)
	if hi - lo <= 1 then return end
	local mid = math.floor((lo + hi) / 2)
	local t = (mid - lo) / (hi - lo)
	pts[mid] = pts[lo]:Lerp(pts[hi], t)
		+ u * ((math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp)
		+ v * ((math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp)
	local nextAmp = amp * decay
	displace(pts, lo, mid, nextAmp, decay, u, v)
	displace(pts, mid, hi, nextAmp, decay, u, v)
end

-- Fills pts[1..segs+1] from startPos toward endPos. jitter=false skips displacement (Scroll base).
-- Sag applies after displacement, since the midpoint recursion would overwrite a pre-applied droop.
local function buildPolyline(pts, segs, startPos, endPos, amp, decay, sag, jitter, sagDir, sagShape)
	local delta = endPos - startPos
	local dist = delta.Magnitude
	for i = 1, segs + 1 do
		pts[i] = startPos + delta * ((i - 1) / segs)
	end
	if jitter and amp ~= 0 then
		local u, v = BoltGen.basis(delta)
		displace(pts, 1, segs + 1, amp, decay, u, v)
	end
	-- Signed: negative sag arches upward. sagShape >= 1 is an exponent profile (1 = parabola).
	-- Below 1 the path morphs through exact circular-arc geometry: 0.5 = circle whose sagitta is
	-- the sag depth, 0 = square trough, between = point-wise blend along the chord-perpendicular of sagDir.
	if sag ~= 0 and dist > 1e-4 then
		local droop = (sagDir or Vector3.yAxis) * (sag >= 0 and -1 or 1)
		local shape = math.max(sagShape or 1, 0)
		local h = math.abs(sag) * dist
		if shape >= 1 then
			for i = 2, segs do
				local t = (i - 1) / segs
				local profile = 4 * t * (1 - t)
				if shape ~= 1 then profile = profile ^ shape end
				pts[i] = pts[i] + droop * (h * profile)
			end
		else
			local u = delta * (1 / dist)
			local bulge = droop - u * droop:Dot(u)
			if bulge.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
				bulge = bulge.Unit
				-- Sagitta circle through both endpoints. Uses acos: Luau's math.atan takes one argument.
				local r = (dist * dist * 0.25 + h * h) / (2 * h)
				local halfSweep = math.acos(math.clamp((r - h) / r, -1, 1))
				local center = startPos + delta * 0.5 + bulge * (h - r)
				for i = 2, segs do
					local t = (i - 1) / segs
					local base = startPos + delta * t
					local phi = (2 * t - 1) * halfSweep
					local arcPt = center + (u * math.sin(phi) + bulge * math.cos(phi)) * r
					local target
					if shape >= 0.5 then
						local parabolaPt = base + bulge * (h * 4 * t * (1 - t))
						target = arcPt:Lerp(parabolaPt, (shape - 0.5) * 2)
					else
						local troughPt = base + bulge * h
						target = troughPt:Lerp(arcPt, shape * 2)
					end
					pts[i] = pts[i] + (target - base)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Writes segment CFrames, lengths and reveal distances into rig slots from slotBase+1.
-- revealBase is the arc distance travelled before this polyline (0 for the main bolt).
local function writeSegments(rig, pts, segs, slotBase, revealBase)
	local arc = revealBase
	for i = 1, segs do
		local p0, p1 = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
		local seg = p1 - p0
		local len = seg.Magnitude
		local slot = slotBase + i
		rig.revealDist[slot] = arc
		if len > 1e-4 then
			rig.rollCFs[slot] = CFrame.lookAt((p0 + p1) * 0.5, p1)
		else
			rig.rollCFs[slot] = CFrame.new((p0 + p1) * 0.5)
		end
		rig.segLen[slot] = math.max(len, MIN_SEG_LEN)
		arc += len
	end
	return arc - revealBase
end

-- One full geometry roll; writes rig buffers only. Returns the main polyline's arc length.
function BoltGen.roll(rig, params, startPos, endPos, farCF)
	-- Per-bolt segment count within the max-sized rig; leftover main slots park far.
	local mainSegs = math.clamp(params._segCount or rig.mainSegs, 2, rig.mainSegs)
	local dist = (endPos - startPos).Magnitude
	local amp = (params._amplitude or 0) * dist
	local mode = params._shapeMode or "Jitter"

	-- Scroll uses a straight+sag base (wave applied per frame by applyScroll); Jitter modes re-roll displacement.
	buildPolyline(rig.ptBuf, mainSegs, startPos, endPos, amp, params._decay or 0.5, params._sag or 0, mode ~= "Scroll",
		params._sagDirWorld, params._sagShape)
	if mode ~= "Jitter" then
		for i = 1, mainSegs + 1 do rig.basePtBuf[i] = rig.ptBuf[i] end
		rig.scrollU, rig.scrollV = BoltGen.basis(endPos - startPos)
		rig.scrollDist = dist
	end
	rig.curSegs = mainSegs
	local totalLen = writeSegments(rig, rig.ptBuf, mainSegs, 0, 0)
	for i = mainSegs + 1, rig.mainSegs do
		rig.rollCFs[i] = farCF
		rig.segLen[i] = MIN_SEG_LEN
		rig.revealDist[i] = math.huge
	end

	-- Depth-1 slots branch off the main polyline; depth-2 off a depth-1 fork that fired this roll.
	local forkSlots = rig.forkSlots
	local depth1Fired = 0
	for slot = 1, forkSlots do
		-- Slot layout is fixed at rig.mainSegs; only the polyline uses the rolled count.
		local slotBase = rig.mainSegs + (slot - 1) * rig.forkSegs
		local depth = rig.slotDepth[slot]
		local fired = false
		if (params._forkChance or 0) > math.random() and (params._forkDepth or 0) >= depth then
			local originPos, originDir, originReveal
			local originIdx, parentSlot, parentPtIdx = 0, 0, 0
			if depth == 1 then
				local idx = math.random(2, mainSegs)
				originPos = rig.ptBuf[idx]
				originDir = (rig.ptBuf[idx + 1] or endPos) - originPos
				-- Point idx starts segment idx; revealDist[idx] is the arc there.
				originReveal = rig.revealDist[idx] or 0
				originIdx = idx
			elseif depth1Fired > 0 then
				local src = math.random(1, depth1Fired)
				originPos = rig.forkAnchorPos[src]
				originDir = rig.forkAnchorDir[src]
				originReveal = rig.forkAnchorReveal[src]
				parentSlot = rig.forkAnchorSlot[src]
				parentPtIdx = rig.forkAnchorPtIdx[src]
			end
			if originPos and originDir and originDir.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
				local scale = (params._forkLenScale or 0.4) ^ depth
				local forkLen = math.max(1, dist * scale)
				local u, v = BoltGen.basis(originDir)
				local phi = math.random() * math.pi * 2
				local axis = u * math.cos(phi) + v * math.sin(phi)
				local ang = FORK_MIN_ANGLE + math.random() * (FORK_MAX_ANGLE - FORK_MIN_ANGLE)
				local forkDir = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, ang):VectorToWorldSpace(originDir.Unit)
				local forkEnd = originPos + forkDir * forkLen
				buildPolyline(rig.forkPtBuf, rig.forkSegs, originPos, forkEnd, amp * scale, params._decay or 0.5, 0, true)
				writeSegments(rig, rig.forkPtBuf, rig.forkSegs, slotBase, originReveal)
				-- Fork geometry is kept local to its root, with the anchor, so scroll modes can re-anchor per frame.
				local lp = rig.forkLocalPts[slot]
				for i = 1, rig.forkSegs + 1 do lp[i] = rig.forkPtBuf[i] - originPos end
				rig.forkOriginIdx[slot] = originIdx or 0
				rig.forkParentSlot[slot] = parentSlot or 0
				rig.forkParentPtIdx[slot] = parentPtIdx or 0
				rig.forkLen[slot] = forkLen
				-- Taper continuation: the parent's arc fraction at the branch point.
				rig.forkStartReveal[slot] = originReveal
				if depth == 1 then
					rig.forkStartFrac[slot] = originReveal / math.max(totalLen, 1e-4)
				else
					local parentStart = rig.forkStartFrac[parentSlot] or 0
					local parentLocal = (originReveal - (rig.forkStartReveal[parentSlot] or 0)) / math.max(rig.forkLen[parentSlot] or 1, 1e-4)
					rig.forkStartFrac[slot] = parentStart + math.clamp(parentLocal, 0, 1) * (1 - parentStart)
				end
				local fu, fv = BoltGen.basis(forkDir)
				rig.forkU[slot], rig.forkV[slot] = fu, fv
				rig.forkSeedU[slot] = math.random() * 100
				rig.forkSeedV[slot] = 100 + math.random() * 100
				if depth == 1 then
					depth1Fired += 1
					local midIdx = math.max(2, math.floor(rig.forkSegs / 2) + 1)
					rig.forkAnchorPos[depth1Fired] = rig.forkPtBuf[midIdx]
					rig.forkAnchorDir[depth1Fired] = forkDir
					rig.forkAnchorReveal[depth1Fired] = originReveal
					rig.forkAnchorSlot[depth1Fired] = slot
					rig.forkAnchorPtIdx[depth1Fired] = midIdx
				end
				fired = true
			end
		end
		if not fired then
			rig.forkOriginIdx[slot] = 0
			rig.forkParentSlot[slot] = 0
			for i = 1, rig.forkSegs do
				local slotIdx = slotBase + i
				rig.rollCFs[slotIdx] = farCF
				rig.segLen[slotIdx] = MIN_SEG_LEN
				rig.revealDist[slotIdx] = math.huge
			end
		end
	end

	-- Farthest segment end (forks included); reverse GrowthSpeed measures back from here.
	local maxReveal = 0
	for i = 1, rig.partCount do
		local rd = rig.revealDist[i]
		if rd ~= math.huge and rd + rig.segLen[i] > maxReveal then
			maxReveal = rd + rig.segLen[i]
		end
	end
	rig.maxReveal = maxReveal

	-- Reveal order by revealDist: in-place insertion sort (few, mostly sorted).
	BoltGen.sortReveal(rig)

	return totalLen
end

-- Diffs live vs parked slots after a roll: fills rig.newlyLiveIdx, updates rig.prevLive and
-- stamps a lastWrittenLen sentinel so planSizes rewrites their Size. Call once per roll.
function BoltGen.diffLive(rig)
	local m = 0
	for i = 1, rig.partCount do
		local live = rig.revealDist[i] ~= math.huge
		if live and not rig.prevLive[i] then
			m += 1
			rig.newlyLiveIdx[m] = i
			rig.lastWrittenLen[i] = -1
		end
		rig.prevLive[i] = live
	end
	return m
end

-- Plans which parts need a Size write: fills rig.sizeWriteIdx and keeps the lastWrittenLen /
-- lastThick caches. Exact compares only. Cross-file: every Size write in Lightning/init.luau
-- must go through this plan or the caches lie.
function BoltGen.planSizes(rig, thick, force)
	local thickChanged = force or thick ~= rig.lastThick
	local n = 0
	for i = 1, rig.partCount do
		if rig.revealDist[i] ~= math.huge then
			local len = rig.segLen[i]
			if thickChanged or len ~= rig.lastWrittenLen[i] then
				n += 1
				rig.sizeWriteIdx[n] = i
				rig.lastWrittenLen[i] = len
			end
		end
	end
	rig.lastThick = thick
	return n
end

-- Per-frame traveling wave (Scroll / JitterScroll): adds 2-octave Perlin offsets to the cached
-- base polyline, pinned at the endpoints, and rewrites MAIN segments in place. Forks stay as rolled.
function BoltGen.applyScroll(rig, params, phase)
	local segs = rig.curSegs
	local u, v = rig.scrollU, rig.scrollV
	if not segs or segs < 2 or not u then return end
	local amp = (params._amplitude or 0) * (rig.scrollDist or 0)
	local waves = params._waves or 3
	local decay = params._decay or 0.5
	local seedA = params._noiseSeedA or 0
	local seedB = params._noiseSeedB or 500
	local pts, base = rig.ptBuf, rig.basePtBuf
	for i = 1, segs + 1 do
		local s = (i - 1) / segs
		-- Squared taper: zero slope at the endpoints so the wave does not kink the exit direction.
		local env = 4 * s * (1 - s)
		env = env * env
		local x1 = s * waves - phase
		local x2 = s * waves * 2.7 - phase * 1.6
		local offU = (math.noise(x1, seedA) + math.noise(x2, seedA + 37.1) * decay) * amp * env
		local offV = (math.noise(x1, seedB) + math.noise(x2, seedB + 37.1) * decay) * amp * env
		pts[i] = base[i] + u * offU + v * offV
	end
	for i = 1, segs do
		local p0, p1 = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
		local seg = p1 - p0
		local len = seg.Magnitude
		if len > 1e-4 then
			rig.rollCFs[i] = CFrame.lookAt((p0 + p1) * 0.5, p1)
		else
			rig.rollCFs[i] = CFrame.new((p0 + p1) * 0.5)
		end
		rig.segLen[i] = math.max(len, MIN_SEG_LEN)
	end
end

-- Per-frame fork re-anchor + scroll. Each fired fork's root follows the current main point
-- (depth-2 follows its parent fork; depth-1 slots come first so parents are up to date), and
-- the fork adds its own wave with a per-slot seed and offset phase.
function BoltGen.applyScrollForks(rig, params, phase)
	local segs = rig.forkSegs
	local waves = params._waves or 3
	for slot = 1, rig.forkSlots do
		local originIdx = rig.forkOriginIdx[slot] or 0
		local parentSlot = rig.forkParentSlot[slot] or 0
		if originIdx ~= 0 or parentSlot ~= 0 then
			local root
			if parentSlot ~= 0 then
				local pw = rig.forkWorldPts[parentSlot]
				root = pw and pw[rig.forkParentPtIdx[slot]]
			else
				root = rig.ptBuf[originIdx]
			end
			if root then
				local lp = rig.forkLocalPts[slot]
				local wp = rig.forkWorldPts[slot]
				local u, v = rig.forkU[slot], rig.forkV[slot]
				local amp = (params._amplitude or 0) * (rig.forkLen[slot] or 1)
				local su = rig.forkSeedU[slot] or 0
				local sv = rig.forkSeedV[slot] or 50
				for i = 1, segs + 1 do
					local s = (i - 1) / segs
					local x1 = s * waves - phase * 1.35
					wp[i] = root + lp[i]
						+ u * (math.noise(x1, su) * amp * s)
						+ v * (math.noise(x1, sv) * amp * s)
				end
				local slotBase = rig.mainSegs + (slot - 1) * segs
				for i = 1, segs do
					local p0, p1 = wp[i], wp[i + 1]
					local d = p1 - p0
					local len = d.Magnitude
					local idx = slotBase + i
					if len > 1e-4 then
						rig.rollCFs[idx] = CFrame.lookAt((p0 + p1) * 0.5, p1)
					else
						rig.rollCFs[idx] = CFrame.new((p0 + p1) * 0.5)
					end
					rig.segLen[idx] = math.max(len, MIN_SEG_LEN)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- In-place insertion sort of revealOrder by revealDist.
function BoltGen.sortReveal(rig)
	local order, rd = rig.revealOrder, rig.revealDist
	for i = 2, rig.partCount do
		local key = order[i]
		local keyDist = rd[key]
		local j = i - 1
		while j >= 1 and rd[order[j]] > keyDist do
			order[j + 1] = order[j]
			j -= 1
		end
		order[j + 1] = key
	end
end

return BoltGen

--[[
	Lightning/Endpoints  -  spawn-shape sampling + live endpoint resolution. Pure pData
	readers/writers; no engine or pool knowledge.
	Origin, in order: an event's origin override, the emitted parent clone of a nested bolt
	(_parentLink), the authored Link by LinkMode (_userLink, through LinkCF.originFrame), the
	source part itself.
]]

local Constants = require(script.Parent.Parent.PartConstants)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.Parent.LinkCF)

local Endpoints = {}

-- Resolves a DisplacementMode-framed vector into world space at the current origin.
-- Local = per-bolt rotated frame (origin x RotXYZ); RigidLocal = origin frame only.
-- Any other mode is read as Local, as PartConstants.resolveDisplacement reads it.
local function resolveDispFrame(pData, startCF, vec)
	local mode = pData._dispMode
	if mode == "Global" then
		return vec
	elseif mode == "RigidLocal" then
		return startCF.Rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(vec)
	end
	local frame = pData._originRot and (startCF.Rotation * pData._originRot) or startCF
	return frame:VectorToWorldSpace(vec)
end

-- Samples the spawn Shape once per bolt: local-frame offset (start scatter) and, in
-- Directional mode, the outward normal as the bolt direction (ShapeInOut applied).
-- Stored shape-local; resolveEndpoints re-applies it against the LIVE frame each roll.
function Endpoints.sampleShape(pData, data, item)
	pData._shapeLocalOffset = nil
	pData._shapeDirLocal = nil
	pData._shapeUsesPart = nil
	if not data.UseShape then return end
	local shapeFunc = Constants.shapeFunctions[data.Shape]
	local shapePart = data.ShapePart
	local shapeSrc = (shapePart and shapePart:IsA("BasePart")) and shapePart
		or (item and item:IsA("BasePart") and item or nil)
	if not shapeFunc or not shapeSrc then return end
	local offset, _, outwardDir = shapeFunc(shapeSrc, { ShapePartial = data.ShapePartial or 0 })
	pData._shapeLocalOffset = offset
	pData._shapeUsesPart = shapeSrc ~= item and shapeSrc or nil
		-- Radial only when explicitly chosen; Emitter mode keeps the authored Direction +- Spread.
	if data.ShapeDirection == "Radial" and pData._endpointMode == "Directional" and outwardDir then
		local sio = data.ShapeInOut
		if sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Inward then
			outwardDir = -outwardDir
		elseif sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.InAndOut and math.random() < 0.5 then
			outwardDir = -outwardDir
		end
		pData._shapeDirLocal = outwardDir
	end
end

-- Seek: casts SEEK_RAYS random directions from the origin and keeps one surface hit within
-- _seekRadius at RANDOM (nearest would collapse every bolt onto one object). SeekBias skews
-- the pick toward closer hits: 0 = uniform, 1 = near-always the nearest. No hit: a fallback
-- direction is cached so the bolt arcs into open air at half radius.
-- _seekNewHit flags a fresh acquisition; Lightning/init fires OnHit from it.
local SEEK_RAYS = 8
local function seekScan(pData, startPos)
	local rayFn = pData._seekRayFn
	if not rayFn then return end
	local radius = pData._seekRadius or 30
	local hits = {}
	for _ = 1, SEEK_RAYS do
		local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1)
		if dir.Magnitude > 1e-3 then
			local hit = rayFn(startPos, dir.Unit * radius)
			if hit then
				hits[#hits + 1] = { hit = hit, dist = (hit.Position - startPos).Magnitude }
			end
		end
	end
	if #hits > 0 then
		table.sort(hits, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
				-- random^(1+bias*8) compresses toward 0 as bias rises, so nearer hits win more often.
		local bias = pData._seekBias or 0
		local skew = math.random() ^ (1 + bias * 8)
		local hit = hits[math.clamp(math.floor(skew * #hits) + 1, 1, #hits)].hit
		pData._seekHit = { Position = hit.Position, Normal = hit.Normal, Instance = hit.Instance }
		pData._seekNewHit = true
	else
		pData._seekHit = nil
		local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1)
		pData._seekFallbackDir = dir.Magnitude > 1e-3 and dir.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
	end
end

-- Advances the glide strike point toward the goal by RetargetSpeed * dt.
-- Returns true when it moved (UpdateLightning re-rolls a frozen-jitter bolt on it).
function Endpoints.glideStep(pData, dt)
	local cur, goal = pData._seekCurrentPos, pData._seekGoalPos
	if (pData._retargetSpeed or 0) <= 0 or not cur or not goal then return false end
	local delta = goal - cur
	local dist = delta.Magnitude
	if dist <= 1e-3 then return false end
	local step = pData._retargetSpeed * dt
	pData._seekCurrentPos = step >= dist and goal or cur + delta * (step / dist)
	return true
end

-- Glide arrival check: OnHit holds until the strike point reaches the goal.
-- Instant mode always counts as arrived.
function Endpoints.glideArrived(pData)
	if (pData._retargetSpeed or 0) <= 0 then return true end
	local cur, goal = pData._seekCurrentPos, pData._seekGoalPos
	if not cur or not goal then return true end
	return (cur - goal).Magnitude <= 1e-2
end

-- Live endpoint resolution, used at emit AND every jitter roll so moving sources / targets /
-- ShapeParts track. Destroyed instances freeze at their last known pose.
-- Returns (startCF for pivot rotation, startPos, endPos).
function Endpoints.resolveEndpoints(pData)
	local startCF
	local link = pData._parentLink
	if pData._startCFOverride then
		startCF = pData._startCFOverride
	elseif link and link.Parent then
				-- Nested emit: origin rides the emitted parent clone, re-resolved every roll.
		startCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
		if pData._parentOffset then
			startCF = startCF * pData._parentOffset
		end
	else
		local src = pData._sourceItem
		local sourceCF = (src and src.Parent) and src.CFrame or pData._lastStartCF or CFrame.new()
		if pData._userLink then
			startCF = LinkCF.originFrame(pData, pData._userLink, src, sourceCF)
		end
		startCF = startCF or sourceCF
	end
	pData._lastStartCF = startCF

	local startPos = startCF.Position
	local dirFrame = startCF
	if pData._shapeLocalOffset then
		local sp = pData._shapeUsesPart
		local frame = (sp and sp.Parent and sp.CFrame) or startCF
		startPos = (frame * CFrame.new(pData._shapeLocalOffset)).Position
		dirFrame = frame
	end

		-- Spawn Pos offset (even-distribution aware, rolled per bolt). Rotation applies FIRST:
		-- Local offsets live in the per-bolt rotated frame, so Rot-even sweeps + Pos offsets
		-- compose into rings/spirals. PosMode Global = raw world axes.
	local off = pData._originOffset
	if off then
		if pData._originOffsetGlobal then
			startPos = startPos + off
		else
			local frame = pData._originRot and (startCF.Rotation * pData._originRot) or startCF
			startPos = startPos + frame:VectorToWorldSpace(off)
		end
	end

		-- Origin motion: accumulated Speed/Accel drift (world) + PosOffset graphs + Turbulence
		-- wander, the latter two in the DisplacementMode frame. Maintained by UpdateLightning.
	local motion = pData._motionOffset
	if motion and motion ~= Vector3.zero then
		startPos = startPos + motion
	end
	local disp = pData._dispRaw
	if disp then
		startPos = startPos + resolveDispFrame(pData, startCF, disp)
	end
	local turb = pData._turbRaw
	if turb then
		startPos = startPos + resolveDispFrame(pData, startCF, turb)
	end

		-- Sag droop axis: down in the DisplacementMode frame (world down when Global), per roll.
	pData._sagDirWorld = resolveDispFrame(pData, startCF, Vector3.yAxis)

	local endPos
	if pData._endpointMode == "Point" then
		local target = pData._target
		if target and target.Parent then
			endPos = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(target).Position
		else
			endPos = pData._lastEndPos or startPos
		end
		local dvec = endPos - startPos
		if dvec.Magnitude > 1e-4 then pData._lastDirWorld = dvec.Unit end
	elseif pData._endpointMode == "Seek" then
				-- Scan on first resolve; re-scan every roll when Retarget. An in-flight glide
				-- finishes before the next re-scan.
		local glideBusy = not Endpoints.glideArrived(pData)
		if (pData._seekRetarget and not glideBusy) or (not pData._seekHit and not pData._seekFallbackDir) then
			seekScan(pData, startPos)
		end
		local goal
		if pData._seekHit then
			goal = pData._seekHit.Position
		else
			goal = startPos + pData._seekFallbackDir * ((pData._seekRadius or 30) * 0.5)
		end
				-- RetargetSpeed > 0: the strike point GLIDES toward the goal (UpdateLightning's glide
				-- block); 0 = instant snap. The first acquisition always snaps.
		pData._seekGoalPos = goal
		if (pData._retargetSpeed or 0) <= 0 or not pData._seekCurrentPos then
			pData._seekCurrentPos = goal
		end
		endPos = pData._seekCurrentPos
		local dvec = endPos - startPos
		if dvec.Magnitude > 1e-4 then pData._lastDirWorld = dvec.Unit end
	else
		local dirVec
		if pData._shapeDirLocal then
			dirVec = dirFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(pData._shapeDirLocal)
		elseif pData._dirGlobal then
			dirVec = pData._dirLocalVec
		else
			dirVec = startCF.Rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(pData._dirLocalVec)
		end
				-- Cached for UpdateLightning's Speed-along-direction origin motion.
		pData._lastDirWorld = dirVec
		endPos = startPos + dirVec * pData._length
	end
	pData._lastStartPos = startPos
	pData._lastEndPos = endPos
	return startCF, startPos, endPos
end

return Endpoints

--[[
	Lightning/ImpactDisk: the flat disk at a bolt's strike point: a thin cylinder whose axis follows
	the surface normal, optionally textured (Decal on the outward face). It exists only while the strike
	ray hits a surface.

	Colour follows the bolt tip: Color graph x Gradient at the far end of the arc. DiskMode "Follow":
	size = DiskSize x thickness ratio x (1 - bolt transparency); transparency and brightness come from
	the bolt graphs. "Manual": the DiskSize / DiskTransparency / DiskBrightness graphs drive it. Reads
	pData._curThick / _curTrans / _curBright written by Lightning/init.luau writeVisuals.

	Normal: Seek bolts use the scan hit; Point / Directional cast one ray along the bolt from its origin
	and re-cast only after the strike point moved RAY_REFRESH_DIST.
	Lifetime: pData._impactDisk is destroyed by LifecycleRelease._releaseVisual and cancelAnimation; it
	lives beside the bolt Model, never inside a pooled Model.
]]

local ContainerFade = require(script.Parent.Parent.Container.Fade)
local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Graph)
local EventsMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Events)

local ImpactDisk = {}

local DISK_THICKNESS = 0.05
local RAY_REFRESH_DIST = 0.5
local RAY_OVERSHOOT = 1.05
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

-- Raycast params for the strike ray (Seek bolts reuse their seek params).
local function buildRayFn(particle, pData)
	local params = EventsMod.makeHitParams(pData)
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	pcall(function()
		params:AddToFilter(particle:GetFolder())
		params:AddToFilter(particle:GetPoolFolder())
	end)
	pData._diskRayFn = function(origin, disp)
		return workspace:Raycast(origin, disp, params)
	end
end

-- Surface normal and disk position for the current endpoints; nil when the bolt hits nothing.
local function resolveSurface(pData, startPos, endPos)
	if pData._endpointMode == "Seek" then
		local hit = pData._seekHit
		if hit then return hit.Normal, endPos end
		return nil
	end
	local last = pData._diskRayPos
	if last and (endPos - last).Magnitude < RAY_REFRESH_DIST then
		return pData._diskNormal, pData._diskHitPos
	end
	pData._diskRayPos = endPos
	local span = endPos - startPos
	local rayFn = pData._seekRayFn or pData._diskRayFn
	local hit = rayFn and span.Magnitude > 1e-4 and rayFn(startPos, span * RAY_OVERSHOOT) or nil
	pData._diskNormal = hit and hit.Normal or nil
	pData._diskHitPos = hit and hit.Position or nil
	return pData._diskNormal, pData._diskHitPos
end

-- The visible surface: the decal on textured disks, the cylinder otherwise.
local function surfaceOf(pData)
	return pData._impactDecal or pData._impactDisk
end

-- The cylinder axis is +X: yaw lookAt's -Z onto the normal so the caps face along it.
function ImpactDisk.place(pData, startPos, endPos)
	local disk = pData._impactDisk
	if not disk or not startPos or not endPos then return end
	local normal, position = resolveSurface(pData, startPos, endPos)
	if not normal then
		if not pData._diskHidden then
			pData._diskHidden = true
			surfaceOf(pData).Transparency = 1
		end
		return
	end
	local lifted = position + normal * (pData._diskOffset or DISK_THICKNESS)
	disk.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(lifted, lifted + normal) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)
	if pData._diskHidden then
		pData._diskHidden = false
		ImpactDisk.write(pData, pData._diskLastT or 0)
	end
end

-- Graph writes at normalized life t (from the bolt's stepped writeVisuals).
function ImpactDisk.write(pData, t)
	local disk = pData._impactDisk
	if not disk then return end
	pData._diskLastT = t
	if pData._diskHidden then return end
	local graphs, seeds = pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds
	local size = graphs.DiskSize and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.DiskSize, seeds.DiskSize) or 2
	local trans, bright
	if pData._diskMode == "Manual" then
		trans = graphs.DiskTransparency and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.DiskTransparency, seeds.DiskTransparency) or 0
		bright = graphs.DiskBrightness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.DiskBrightness, seeds.DiskBrightness) or 1
	else
		trans = pData._curTrans or 0
		bright = pData._curBright or 1
		local thick0 = pData._diskThick0 or 0
		local thickRatio = thick0 > 1e-4 and (pData._curThick or thick0) / thick0 or 1
		size = size * thickRatio * math.clamp(1 - trans, 0, 1)
	end
	disk.Size = Vector3.new(DISK_THICKNESS, math.max(0.05, size), math.max(0.05, size))

	local base = graphs.Color and GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.Color) or pData._diskBaseColor or WHITE
	local tip = pData._diskTipTint
	local r, g, b = base.R * bright, base.G * bright, base.B * bright
	if tip then r, g, b = r * tip.R, g * tip.G, b * tip.B end
	local color = Color3.new(math.min(r, 1), math.min(g, 1), math.min(b, 1))
	-- A Container's Transparency fades the disk too (Container/Fade); its size keeps its own.
	local shown = ContainerFade.number(trans, ContainerFade.of(pData._drive))
	local decal = pData._impactDecal
	if decal then
		decal.Transparency = shown
		decal.Color3 = color
	else
		disk.Transparency = shown
		disk.Color = color
	end
end

-- Creates the disk for a bolt whose endpoints were rolled once (applyRoll at emit).
function ImpactDisk.attach(particle, pData, data)
	if not data.DiskEnabled or pData._impactDisk then return end
	local model = pData.VisualPart
	if not model or not model.Parent then return end
	local disk = Instance.new("Part")
	disk.Name = "ImpactDisk"
	disk.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	disk.Anchored = true
	disk.CanCollide = false
	disk.CanQuery = false
	disk.CanTouch = false
	disk.Massless = true
	disk.CastShadow = false
	disk.Locked = true
	disk.Archivable = false
	disk.Size = Vector3.new(DISK_THICKNESS, 1, 1)
	local baseColor = WHITE
	pcall(function()
		disk.Material = data.RenderTemplate.Material
		baseColor = data.RenderTemplate.Color
	end)
	local texture = data.DiskTexture
	if type(texture) == "string" and texture ~= "" then
		local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
		decal.Name = "Face"
		decal.Face = Enum.NormalId.Right
		decal.Texture = texture
		decal.Parent = disk
		-- Textured disks show only the decal.
		disk.Transparency = 1
		pData._impactDecal = decal
	end
	-- A bolt a Matte carries is a window in its layer (Matte/init _matteCarry); no disk.
	if pData._matteCarried then
		disk.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
		if pData._impactDecal then
			pData._impactDecal.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
		end
	end
	pData._impactDisk = disk
	pData._diskMode = data.DiskMode or "Follow"
	pData._diskOffset = data.DiskOffset or DISK_THICKNESS
	pData._diskThick0 = pData._curThick or 0.15
	pData._diskBaseColor = baseColor
	local gradient = pData.Graphs.Gradient
	pData._diskTipTint = gradient and GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(1, gradient) or nil
	pData._diskHidden = false
	pData._diskLastT = 0
	pData._diskRayPos = nil
	pData._diskNormal = nil
	pData._diskHitPos = nil
	pData.Graphs.DiskSize = data.DiskSize
	pData.Graphs.DiskTransparency = data.DiskTransparency
	pData.Graphs.DiskBrightness = data.DiskBrightness
	pData.Seeds.DiskSize = data.DiskSize and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.DiskSize) or {}
	pData.Seeds.DiskTransparency = data.DiskTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.DiskTransparency) or {}
	pData.Seeds.DiskBrightness = data.DiskBrightness and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.DiskBrightness) or {}
	if pData._endpointMode ~= "Seek" then buildRayFn(particle, pData) end
	disk.Parent = model.Parent
	ImpactDisk.place(pData, pData._lastStartPos, pData._lastEndPos)
	ImpactDisk.write(pData, 0)
end

function ImpactDisk.detach(pData)
	local disk = pData._impactDisk
	if disk then pcall(function() disk:Destroy() end) end
	pData._impactDisk = nil
	pData._impactDecal = nil
	pData._diskRayFn = nil
	pData._diskTipTint = nil
end

-- AnimateLoop cycle: rebuild against the fresh data (DiskEnabled / DiskMode may have flipped).
function ImpactDisk.refresh(particle, pData, freshData)
	ImpactDisk.detach(pData)
	ImpactDisk.attach(particle, pData, freshData)
end

return ImpactDisk

--[[
	Lightning/PDataBuilder: per-bolt pData construction shared by Emit and Animate. Rolls every
	per-bolt range, composes the launch frame (RotXYZ + DirMode + Spread), samples spawn Pos/Shape and
	seeds the origin-motion state. emitCtx carries per-burst EmitIndex/EvenOffset for even-distribution
	sampling.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Range)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.AxisLinks)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.Parent.PartConstants)
local TurbulenceMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Turbulence)
local EndpointsMod = require(script.Parent.Endpoints)

local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

local PDataBuilder = {}

-- Flat-zero sequences (the writeDefaults stamp) count as no graph, so idle emitters skip motion accumulation.
function PDataBuilder.liveGraph(seq)
	if not seq then return nil end
	if GraphMod.IsStatic(seq) and GraphMod.GetStaticValue(seq, 0) == 0 then return nil end
	return seq
end

-- A static-white ColorSequence (the writeDefaults stamp) counts as no gradient: default bolts keep the single-colour path.
function PDataBuilder.liveColor(seq)
	if not seq or typeof(seq) ~= "ColorSequence" then return nil end
	local kp = seq.Keypoints
	if #kp <= 1 then
		local c = kp[1] and kp[1].Value
		if not c or (c.R > 0.999 and c.G > 0.999 and c.B > 0.999) then return nil end
	end
	return seq
end

-- A flat-one Taper profile (the writeDefaults stamp) counts as no taper: the per-roll width pass is skipped.
function PDataBuilder.liveProfile(seq)
	if not seq or typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then return nil end
	if GraphMod.IsStatic(seq) and GraphMod.GetStaticValue(seq, 0) == 1 then return nil end
	return seq
end

function PDataBuilder.build(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	-- Normalize motion graphs before seeding/aliasing so downstream flags see nil.
	data.ThicknessProfile = PDataBuilder.liveProfile(data.ThicknessProfile)
	data.Speed = PDataBuilder.liveGraph(data.Speed)
	data.PosOffsetX = PDataBuilder.liveGraph(data.PosOffsetX)
	data.PosOffsetY = PDataBuilder.liveGraph(data.PosOffsetY)
	data.PosOffsetZ = PDataBuilder.liveGraph(data.PosOffsetZ)
	data.Turbulence = TurbulenceMod.isLive(data.Turbulence)
	local seeds = {
		Brightness = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Brightness),
		Transparency = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Transparency),
		Thickness = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Thickness),
		ThicknessProfile = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ThicknessProfile),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
		Speed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Speed),
		PosOffsetX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetX),
		PosOffsetY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetY),
		PosOffsetZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetZ),
		Turbulence = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Turbulence),
	}
	-- Linked graph axes (PosOffset) adopt the primary's graph and seed.
	AxisLinksMod.applyGraphAxisAliases(data, seeds, data.AxisLinks)
	local accel = data.Acceleration or Vector3.zero
	local growthSpeed = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.GrowthSpeed)
	local pData = {
		Type = "Lightning",
		VisualPart = model,
		_rig = rig,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = lifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		_sourceItem = item,

		Graphs = {
			Color = data.Color,
			Gradient = PDataBuilder.liveColor(data.Gradient),
			Brightness = data.Brightness,
			Transparency = data.Transparency,
			Thickness = data.Thickness,
			ThicknessProfile = data.ThicknessProfile,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
			Speed = data.Speed,
			PosOffsetX = data.PosOffsetX,
			PosOffsetY = data.PosOffsetY,
			PosOffsetZ = data.PosOffsetZ,
			Turbulence = data.Turbulence,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, lifeTime),

		_endpointMode = data.TargetMode == "Seek" and "Seek"
			or ((data.TargetMode == "Point" and data.Target and data.Target.Parent) and "Point" or "Directional"),
		_target = data.Target,
		-- The authored Link. A top-level bolt's origin rides it by LinkMode; a nested bolt rides its parent
		-- clone (Endpoints.resolveEndpoints).
		_userLink = data.Link,
		-- Carried by a Container or a Matte: its place on the parent clone (NestedEmit.keepPlace).
		_parentOffset = emitCtx and emitCtx._rigPlace or nil,
		-- Carried by a Container: its record, for its Transparency (Container/Fade).
		_drive = emitCtx and emitCtx._containerDrive or nil,
		LinkMode = data.LinkMode,
		LinkAxes = data.LinkAxes,
		_seekRadius = math.max(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.SeekRadius), 1),
		_seekRetarget = data.SeekRetarget == true,
		_seekBias = math.clamp(data.SeekBias or 0, 0, 1),
		_retargetSpeed = math.max(data.RetargetSpeed or 0, 0),
		-- Seek fires OnHit from its own scan (fireSeekHit); Events.afterUpdate's raycast and Collision actions must skip this pData.
		_ownsOnHit = true,
		_length = math.max(0.1, RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Length)),
		-- Bolt-shape ranges roll once per bolt: varied across a burst, stable within a bolt.
		_segCount = math.clamp(math.floor(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.SegmentCount) + 0.5), 2, rig.mainSegs),
		_amplitude = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Amplitude),
		_decay = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.AmplitudeDecay),
		_forkChance = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ForkChance),
		_forkDepth = math.floor(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ForkDepth) + 0.5),
		_forkLenScale = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ForkLengthScale),
		_sag = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Sag),
		_sagShape = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.SagShape),
		_shapeMode = data.ShapeMode or "Jitter",
		_scrollSpeed = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ScrollSpeed),
		_waves = math.max(0.25, RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Waves)),
		_scrollPhase = 0,
		_noiseSeedA = math.random() * 1000,
		_noiseSeedB = 500 + math.random() * 1000,
		_jitterAccum = 0,
		_lSpeed = growthSpeed,
		_growReversed = growthSpeed < 0,
		_tipDist = 0,
		_revealPtr = 0,
		_nestedAlive = { true },

		-- Origin motion (Speed along launch direction + Acceleration + Drag) and PosOffset graphs, accumulated
		-- per frame in UpdateLightning and applied by resolveEndpoints each roll.
		_accel = accel,
		_drag = data.Drag or 0,
		_dispMode = data.DisplacementMode or "Global",
		_motionOffset = Vector3.zero,
		_motionAccelVel = Vector3.zero,
		_hasMotion = data.Speed ~= nil or accel.Magnitude > 0,
		_hasDisp = data.PosOffsetX ~= nil or data.PosOffsetY ~= nil or data.PosOffsetZ ~= nil,
		-- Origin turbulence: sampled per frame into _turbRaw, applied by resolveEndpoints in the _dispMode frame.
		_hasTurb = data.Turbulence ~= nil,
		_turbFreq = data.TurbulenceFrequency or 1,
		_turbSeed = math.random() * 997 + 0.5,
		_turbRaw = nil,
	}
	local jitterHz = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.JitterRate)
	pData._jitterInterval = jitterHz > 0 and 1 / jitterHz or math.huge

	-- Directional launch axis in SOURCE-local space: EmissionDirection rotated by RotXYZ (even-distribution
	-- aware) +- SpreadAngle. Spawn Pos offsets the origin in the origin frame (PosMode Global = world
	-- axes), applied per roll by resolveEndpoints so moving sources and links carry the pattern.
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
	local localAxis = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	local spread = data.SpreadAngle or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", rotS.RotX or 0, rotS.RotY or 0, rotS.RotZ or 0)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, localAxis)
	-- Direction takes RotXYZ only in DirMode=Local; RigidLocal keeps the authored facing so Rot drives the Pos frame alone.
	if data.DirMode == "Local" then cf = cf * rotXYZ end
	if spread.X > 0 or spread.Y > 0 then
		cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(
			math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.X),
			math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.Y), 0)
	end
	pData._dirLocalVec = cf.LookVector
	pData._dirGlobal = data.DirMode == "Global"
	-- Rotation applies before position offsets: Local Pos and displacement frames live in the per-bolt rotated frame.
	pData._originRot = rotXYZ
	local posS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"PosX","PosY","PosZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local px, py, pz = posS.PosX or 0, posS.PosY or 0, posS.PosZ or 0
	if px ~= 0 or py ~= 0 or pz ~= 0 then
		pData._originOffset = Vector3.new(px, py, pz)
		pData._originOffsetGlobal = data.PosMode == "Global"
	else
		pData._originOffset = nil
	end
	EndpointsMod.sampleShape(pData, data, item)
	return pData
end

return PDataBuilder

--[[
	Lightning/Rig  -  bolt Model + rig-buffer construction and pool acquire.
	Owns the weak-keyed Rigs map so buffers survive pool release/acquire cycles and gc with the model.
]]

local Pool = require(script.Parent.Parent.Pool)
local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Graph)
local BoltGen = require(script.Parent.BoltGen)

local MAX_BOLT_PARTS = 64
local FAR_CFRAME = CFrame.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)

local Rig = {}

Rig.MAX_BOLT_PARTS = MAX_BOLT_PARTS
Rig.FAR_CFRAME = FAR_CFRAME

Rig.Rigs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

-- One segment part cloned from the RT. copyBare strips Transformed children (nested source
-- Part-Icles fire once per BOLT via NestedEmit.walk). Returns the first Decal/Texture child
-- too: Transform hides RT decals, so writeVisuals must drive them alongside the part.
local function buildSegment(rt)
	local seg = Pool.copyBare(rt)
	seg.Anchored = true
	seg.CanCollide = false
	seg.CanQuery = false
	seg.CanTouch = false
	seg.Massless = true
	seg.Locked = true
	seg.Archivable = false
	seg.Transparency = 0
	local decal = seg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal") or seg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Texture")
	return seg, decal
end

-- Rig layout sizes for the range MAXIMUMS; each bolt rolls its own values within them and
-- parks unused slots at FAR_CFRAME.
function Rig.layoutFor(data)
	return BoltGen.layout(data.SegmentCount.Max, data.ForkDepth.Max, data.ForkChance.Max, MAX_BOLT_PARTS)
end

-- Fresh bolt Model + rig with every buffer pre-sized. Called on pool miss or when the
-- rig check fails on a pool hit.
function Rig.buildRig(data)
	local partCount, mainSegs, forkSegs, forkSlots = Rig.layoutFor(data)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "LightningBolt"
	model.Archivable = false
	model:SetAttribute("_lightningBolt", true)
	local rig = {
		partCount = partCount, mainSegs = mainSegs,
		forkSegs = forkSegs, forkSlots = forkSlots,
		parts = table.create(partCount),
		rollCFs = table.create(partCount),
		writeCFs = table.create(partCount),
		segLen = table.create(partCount),
		revealDist = table.create(partCount),
		revealOrder = table.create(partCount),
		widthScale = table.create(partCount),
		decals = table.create(partCount),
		slotDepth = table.create(math.max(forkSlots, 1)),
		ptBuf = table.create(mainSegs + 1),
		basePtBuf = table.create(mainSegs + 1),
		forkPtBuf = table.create(forkSegs + 1),
		forkAnchorPos = {}, forkAnchorDir = {}, forkAnchorReveal = {},
		forkAnchorSlot = {}, forkAnchorPtIdx = {},
		forkOriginIdx = {}, forkParentSlot = {}, forkParentPtIdx = {},
		forkLen = {}, forkU = {}, forkV = {}, forkSeedU = {}, forkSeedV = {},
		forkStartReveal = {}, forkStartFrac = {},
		forkLocalPts = {}, forkWorldPts = {},
		prevLive = table.create(partCount),
		lastWrittenLen = table.create(partCount),
		sizeWriteIdx = table.create(partCount),
		newlyLiveIdx = table.create(partCount),
		gradColor = table.create(partCount),
		taper = table.create(partCount),
	}
	for slot = 1, forkSlots do
		rig.forkLocalPts[slot] = table.create(forkSegs + 1)
		rig.forkWorldPts[slot] = table.create(forkSegs + 1)
		rig.forkOriginIdx[slot] = 0
		rig.forkParentSlot[slot] = 0
	end
		-- Slot depth is fixed at build: first half depth 1, remainder depth 2. Width per part is
		-- a build-time constant (main = 1, forks scale by ForkLengthScale^depth).
	local depth1Slots = forkSlots > 0 and math.max(1, math.ceil(forkSlots / 2)) or 0
	for slot = 1, forkSlots do
		rig.slotDepth[slot] = slot <= depth1Slots and 1 or 2
	end
		-- Fork WIDTH has a floor: at small length scales length-coupled widths shrink forks to
		-- invisible hairlines.
	local lenScale = math.max(0.45, data.ForkLengthScale and data.ForkLengthScale.Max or 0.4)
	for i = 1, partCount do
		local seg, decal = buildSegment(data.RenderTemplate)
		seg.Name = "Seg" .. i
		seg.CFrame = FAR_CFRAME
		seg.Parent = model
		rig.parts[i] = seg
		rig.decals[i] = decal
		rig.rollCFs[i] = FAR_CFRAME
		rig.writeCFs[i] = FAR_CFRAME
		rig.segLen[i] = 0.05
		rig.revealDist[i] = math.huge
		rig.revealOrder[i] = i
		rig.prevLive[i] = false
				-- Sentinel: the first planSizes write is unconditional per part.
		rig.lastWrittenLen[i] = -1
		rig.taper[i] = 1
		if i <= mainSegs then
			rig.widthScale[i] = 1
		else
			local slot = math.floor((i - mainSegs - 1) / forkSegs) + 1
			rig.widthScale[i] = lenScale ^ (rig.slotDepth[slot] or 1)
		end
	end
	Rig.Rigs[model] = rig
	return model, rig
end

-- Per-part width multiplier from the Taper profile (arc 0 = source, 1 = tip). Main parts read
-- their arc fraction of the main polyline; fork parts continue the parent's fraction at the
-- branch point to 1 over the fork's own length. A changed multiplier stamps the planSizes
-- force sentinel so the next flush resizes that part. No profile = every multiplier 1.
function Rig.applyTaper(rig, profile, seed, mainLen)
	local invMain = 1 / math.max(mainLen or 0, 1e-4)
	for i = 1, rig.partCount do
		local revealDist = rig.revealDist[i]
		local value = 1
		if profile and revealDist ~= math.huge then
			local frac
			if i <= rig.mainSegs then
				frac = (revealDist + rig.segLen[i] * 0.5) * invMain
			else
				local slot = math.floor((i - rig.mainSegs - 1) / rig.forkSegs) + 1
				local startFrac = rig.forkStartFrac[slot] or 0
				local along = revealDist - (rig.forkStartReveal[slot] or 0) + rig.segLen[i] * 0.5
				local localFrac = math.clamp(along / math.max(rig.forkLen[slot] or 1, 1e-4), 0, 1)
				frac = startFrac + localFrac * (1 - startFrac)
			end
			value = math.max(GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(math.clamp(frac, 0, 1), profile, seed), 0)
		end
		if value ~= rig.taper[i] then
			rig.taper[i] = value
			rig.lastWrittenLen[i] = -1
		end
	end
end

-- Rebuilds the GrowthSpeed reveal mask against the current _tipDist over the sorted reveal
-- order. reversed = negative GrowthSpeed: the strike travels from the far end back toward
-- the source. Returns the new reveal pointer.
local function rebuildRevealMask(rig, tipDist, reversed)
	local ptr = 0
	local maxReveal = rig.maxReveal or 0
	for k = 1, rig.partCount do
		local idx = rig.revealOrder[k]
		local rd = rig.revealDist[idx]
		local visible
		if reversed then
			visible = rd ~= math.huge and (rd + rig.segLen[idx]) >= (maxReveal - tipDist)
		else
			visible = rd <= tipDist
		end
		if visible then
			rig.writeCFs[idx] = rig.rollCFs[idx]
			ptr = k
		else
			rig.writeCFs[idx] = FAR_CFRAME
		end
	end
	return ptr
end

-- Shared CFrame flush: reveal mask (GrowthSpeed) + batch write. atEmit runs before the model
-- is parented, so it writes CFrames directly (BulkMoveTo requires workspace ancestry).
function Rig.flushCFrames(pData, atEmit)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local useReveal = pData._lSpeed ~= 0
	if useReveal then
		pData._revealPtr = rebuildRevealMask(rig, pData._tipDist or 0, pData._growReversed)
	end
	local cfs = useReveal and rig.writeCFs or rig.rollCFs
	if atEmit then
		for i = 1, rig.partCount do rig.parts[i].CFrame = cfs[i] end
	else
		workspace:BulkMoveTo(rig.parts, cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
	end
end

-- Pool acquire with a rig re-check: a foreign or mutilated model, or a layout change that
-- slipped past the _PoolGen flush, rebuilds fresh.
function Rig.acquireBolt(data)
	local expected = Rig.layoutFor(data)
	if data.Pool ~= false then
		local model = Pool.acquire(data.RenderTemplate, "Lightning")
		if model then
			local rig = Rig.Rigs[model]
			if rig and rig.partCount == expected and rig.parts[1] and rig.parts[1].Parent == model then
				model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
				return model, rig
			end
			pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
		end
	end
	local model, rig = Rig.buildRig(data)
	model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	return model, rig
end

return Rig
